66014.recognize_zh: 抹片中母細胞有兩型：紅箭頭為細胞質深嗜鹼、核圓的紅系母細胞，藍箭頭為細胞質淡嗜鹼且有泡狀突起（blebs）的巨核系母細胞；切片見成片母細胞夾雜異型巨核細胞，NPM1 免疫染色呈核與細胞質共同陽性（突變型）。
features: Panel A: blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei and visible nucleoli (erythroid-type, red arrow)
Panel A: blast with paler basophilic cytoplasm showing cytoplasmic blebs and ovoid nucleus (megakaryoblast-type, blue arrow)
Panel B: marrow biopsy with sheets of blasts and interspersed small dysplastic megakaryocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Panel C: CD71 diffuse positivity in the blast population
Panel D: CD61 positivity in a subset of cells with membranous/cytoplasmic pattern
Panel E: NPM1 immunostain with both nuclear and cytoplasmic reactivity (mutant pattern)
66014.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts, including cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, and nucleoli suggestive of erythroid differentiation, and cells with paler cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs suggestive of megakaryocytic differentiation. The core biopsy shows sheets of blasts with scattered dysplastic megakaryocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows CD71 positivity in the blast population, CD61 positivity in a subset, and aberrant cytoplasmic plus nuclear NPM1 staining consistent with an NPM1 mutation. Findings are consistent with NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid and megakaryocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: AEL shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, usually with complex karyotype and TP53 mutation, and NPM1 staining is nuclear-restricted.
AMKL shows megakaryoblasts with blebs and marrow fibrosis but lacks the mutant cytoplasmic NPM1 pattern and has its own genetic drivers (e.g., RBM15::MRTFA in infants).
AML-MR is defined by MDS-related cytogenetic/gene mutations or prior MDS; an NPM1 mutation takes precedence and excludes this category.
Non-hematopoietic tumors form cohesive clusters and are negative for CD71, CD61 and myeloid markers while expressing lineage-specific markers.

66014.stain: Giemsa; H&E; IHC CD71, CD61, NPM1

64862.recognize_zh: 這張其實不是 H&E，而是骨髓切片的免疫組織化學染色：幾乎所有中等大小的腫瘤細胞，細胞質都有棕色顆粒狀、點狀的陽性。這種 cytotoxic granule 型的染色分布，放在 EBV 陽性 NK 細胞白血病的背景下，支持 aggressive NK-cell leukemia 的瀰漫性浸潤。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like interstitial infiltrate replacing marrow, with only a few residual adipocytes
Medium to large cells with round to oval, pale hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Scant to moderate cytoplasm with coarse granular/dot-like brown (DAB) immunoreactivity in most cells
Granular cytoplasmic pattern resembles cytotoxic granule protein staining (e.g., TIA-1/granzyme B/perforin), but the antibody is not labeled
Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not identifiable in this field
64862.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section stained by immunohistochemistry (not H&E as titled), with hematoxylin counterstain. The marrow is diffusely replaced by sheets of medium to large atypical cells with round to oval nuclei. Most infiltrating cells show granular, dot-like cytoplasmic immunoreactivity, a pattern typical of cytotoxic granule-associated proteins, although the specific antibody is not identified in the image. Residual normal hematopoiesis is not evident in this field. In the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context (CD3ε+, surface CD3−, CD56+, EBER+), findings are consistent with marrow involvement by aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: Shares the same NK phenotype and EBV positivity; separation relies on clinical presentation (leukemic, multiorgan, fulminant course versus a nasal/extranodal mass) rather than marrow morphology.
T-LGL shows a subtle interstitial/intrasinusoidal infiltrate of small mature cells that are surface CD3+, CD8+ and EBV-negative, not diffuse sheets of atypical cells.
HSTCL shows a mainly intrasinusoidal pattern of monomorphic γδ T cells that are EBER-negative and usually lack cytotoxic granule protein expression other than TIA-1.
AML blasts would be MPO/CD33/CD34/CD117 positive and EBER-negative, lacking the NK-associated cytotoxic granule and CD56/CD3ε profile.

65502.recognize_zh: H&E 400 倍下，淋巴結大片被泡沫狀、淡粉紅色的組織球取代，組織球內可見許多小而圓、帶透明暈的空泡狀菌體；中下方殘留一片小淋巴球。整片「泡泡狀」組織球加上幾乎沒有肉芽腫反應，應想到 HIV 病人的 Cryptococcus 感染。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale, bubbly cytoplasm replacing lymph node architecture
Numerous small round intracytoplasmic yeasts with clear halos, giving a soap-bubble pattern
Scattered residual small lymphocytes forming a central band
Absence of well-formed granulomas or necrosis in this field
Bland spindle to oval histiocyte and endothelial nuclei
65502.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy, H&E, shows effacement by sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm. At higher magnification the vacuoles contain numerous round yeast forms of variable size surrounded by clear capsular halos, producing a soap-bubble pattern; residual small lymphocytes are present centrally and well-formed granulomas are absent. Findings are suggestive of cryptococcal lymphadenitis in an immunocompromised host; special stains (mucicarmine, GMS) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MAC produces sheets of foamy or striated histiocytes without discrete round yeasts, and the organisms are acid-fast bacilli.
Histoplasma yeasts are tiny (2–4 µm) and uniform within histiocytes, lacking variably sized yeasts with wide clear capsules.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive, show emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and plasma cells, and contain no organisms.
Carcinoma shows cohesive atypical epithelial cells with keratin positivity rather than bland histiocytes packed with capsule-bearing yeasts.

65438.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色可見 B 細胞排成線狀、串珠狀沿骨髓竇分布，BCL2 與 IgD 呈相同竇內分布，H&E 上浸潤不明顯，是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤典型的竇內浸潤模式。
features: CD20 highlights linear and cord-like chains of B cells within marrow sinusoids (intrasinusoidal pattern)
BCL2 and IgD stain the same intrasinusoidal lymphoid cells
H&E shows cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis in which the intrasinusoidal infiltrate is inconspicuous
No discrete paratrabecular or nodular aggregates in the fields shown
Pseudo-Auer rod inclusions cannot be assessed on this fixed trephine/IHC image
65438.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis on H&E, in which a lymphoid infiltrate is not readily apparent. Immunohistochemistry for CD20 highlights an infiltrate of small B cells arranged in linear, intrasinusoidal chains, and these cells co-express BCL2 and IgD. The cytoplasmic Auer rod-like inclusions named in the title are not assessable in this biopsy image and are seen only on the smears. Findings are consistent with involvement by splenic marginal zone lymphoma with a predominantly intrasinusoidal pattern.

ddx.vs: HCL shows diffuse interstitial 'fried-egg' infiltrates with reticulin fibrosis and is CD25/CD103/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive, rather than IgD-positive intrasinusoidal chains.
HSTCL is also intrasinusoidal but the cells are CD3-positive, CD20-negative gamma-delta T cells.
MCL may show intrasinusoidal spread but is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD5-positive, typically with nodular/interstitial aggregates.
CLL forms nodular or diffuse interstitial infiltrates of CD5/CD23/LEF1-positive cells rather than a predominantly sinusoidal pattern.

65374.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中三顆中型淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質均勻，淡藍灰色細胞質四周伸出細毛狀突起，是毛細胞（hairy cell）的樣子。
features: Three medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei
Homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Fine, irregular hair-like cytoplasmic projections around the cell border
Thick smear area with closely packed red cells; magnification limits fine detail
65374.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at moderate magnification shows three medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections. Nucleoli are not conspicuous, and no other leukocytes are present in this field. Evaluation is limited by magnification and smear thickness. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells have a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25, ANXA1 and BRAF V600E.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and lack the CD103/CD25/CD123 co-expression of hairy cells.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm rather than round nuclei with hairy borders.

65310.recognize_zh: 毛囊漏斗部管腔內有一隻細長、外有薄殼、內含顆粒狀物質的節肢動物體，位置緊鄰下方皮脂腺，形態符合毛囊蟲（Demodex folliculorum）；周圍毛囊上皮與真皮無明顯發炎。
features: Elongated, cigar-shaped mite within a dilated follicular infundibulum
Thin refractile chitinous exoskeleton enclosing granular internal contents
Surrounding stratified follicular epithelium is intact with no significant inflammatory infiltrate
Adjacent sebaceous lobules with clear vacuolated sebocytes
Black pigment fragment within the follicular lumen, likely extraneous material
65310.describe_en: Scalp skin biopsy shows a hair follicle with an adjacent sebaceous gland. Within the dilated follicular infundibulum there is an elongated mite with a thin refractile exoskeleton and granular internal contents, consistent with Demodex folliculorum. The follicular epithelium is intact and there is no significant perifollicular inflammation, granuloma formation, or follicular rupture in this field. An extraneous black pigment fragment is noted in the lumen. Findings are consistent with incidental Demodex folliculorum infestation of the hair follicle.

ddx.vs: D. brevis is shorter and resides within sebaceous and meibomian glands rather than the follicular lumen.
Scabies mites are round, lie in burrows within the stratum corneum, and are not intrafollicular.
Pathogenic demodicosis shows multiple mites per follicle with perifollicular lymphohistiocytic or granulomatous inflammation, absent in this field.

65182.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量成熟小淋巴球，許多細胞核呈雙核、裂隙或三葉草狀（cloverleaf），偶見核間橋，背景有多個破碎細胞（smudge cells）；淋巴結切片為瀰漫小淋巴球且 cyclin D1 陰性，屬非典型形態的 CLL/SLL。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of small to medium mature lymphocytes with scant to moderate faintly basophilic cytoplasm
Many lymphocytes with binucleated or deeply cleaved nuclei; occasional cloverleaf-shaped (trilobed) nuclei and internuclear bridges
Condensed, clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Numerous smudge cells in the background
Lymph node: diffuse sheets of small lymphocytes; cyclin D1 negative in lymphoma cells (only scattered positive background cells)
65182.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed of small to medium-sized mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. A substantial proportion of the cells show binucleated, cleaved or cloverleaf-shaped nuclei, occasionally with internuclear bridges, and smudge cells are numerous. The corresponding lymph node shows diffuse effacement by small lymphocytes that are cyclin D1 negative. With a CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ immunophenotype and trisomy 12, findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with atypical nuclear morphology.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have hyperlobated 'flower' nuclei but are CD4+ T cells with HTLV-1 infection, whereas these are CD5+/CD19+/CD23+ B cells.
PPBL shows binucleated lymphocytes in young female smokers with polyclonal B cells and HLA-DR7, not a monoclonal kappa CD5+/CD23+ population.
MCL cells have irregular cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-/CD200- and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas cyclin D1 was negative here.
FL buttock/cleaved cells are CD10+ and CD5-, unlike this CD5+/CD10- population.

65118.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小正常、不腫大，內含許多細小的環狀滋養體（ring forms），可見雙染色質點、邊緣貼附型（appliqué）以及同一顆紅血球內多隻寄生蟲；視野中未見大型滋養體或裂殖體，這些都是熱帶瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的典型線索。
features: Normal-sized, non-enlarged red cells infected by delicate small ring-form trophozoites
Rings with thin cytoplasmic loops and one or two chromatin dots (double-dot/headphone forms)
Frequent multiply infected red cells containing 2-4 parasites
Marginal (appliqué/accolé) forms along the red cell membrane
No mature trophozoites, schizonts or Schuffner dots; fine background stain precipitate on red cells
65118.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells infected with small, delicate ring-form trophozoites. Many rings show double chromatin dots, several are applied to the red cell margin, and multiple red cells contain two to four parasites. Infected erythrocytes are not enlarged and lack Schuffner stippling, and no mature trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection; parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic, lack hemozoin pigment and may form extracellular forms and Maltese-cross tetrads; travel/tick history and PCR help separate them.
P. vivax infects enlarged red cells with Schuffner dots and shows amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts, with multiple infection being uncommon.
Early rings of P. knowlesi resemble P. falciparum, but band-form trophozoites and schizonts are present in peripheral blood and PCR confirms species.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets and precipitate lack a ring of cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.

64990.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆細胞核偏於一側、細胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，染色質呈車輪狀，其中有雙核漿細胞與較大、核仁可見的不成熟漿細胞，數量明顯增加，支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, including clusters, among residual granulocytic precursors
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin; some immature forms with visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear Golgi zone (hof)
Binucleated and occasional multinucleated plasma cells; some with irregular cytoplasmic blebs
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; red cells in the background overlap but definite rouleaux stacks are not clearly appreciated in these crops
64990.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a prominent increase in plasma cells, occurring singly and in small clusters. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof; binucleated forms and immature plasma cells with nucleoli are present. Residual myeloid precursors and segmented neutrophils are seen. Rouleaux, although described clinically, is not convincingly demonstrated in these cropped fields. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification on a 500-cell differential, CD138 immunohistochemistry and light-chain restriction studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% of marrow cells, lack binucleation/nucleoli and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominant sheet of atypical plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof located away from the nucleus and occur in loose clusters, and are CD138-negative.
Plasmablastic cells are large with prominent nucleoli and high proliferation, often EBV-positive, with extramedullary presentation.

64926.recognize_zh: 白色箭頭指的紅血球變大，內含圓形寄生蟲佔滿整個細胞，胞質粉紫色並散佈細顆粒狀褐色色素，邊緣略呈鋸齒，沒有裂殖子分節，符合間日瘧配子體。
features: Enlarged red cell completely occupied by a round parasite
Finely granular pink-purple parasite cytoplasm with dispersed brown pigment
Slightly irregular, crenated host-cell outline
No discrete merozoites; single parasite without segmentation
Uninfected erythrocytes normocytic and normochromic
64926.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic erythrocytes. A single enlarged red cell is filled by a round parasite with granular cytoplasm and finely dispersed pigment, without segmentation into merozoites. No crescent-shaped gametocytes or multiple ring forms are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax gametocyte; the image resolution does not allow reliable distinction of macro- from microgametocyte.

ddx.vs: Falciparum gametocytes are crescentic and elongate rather than round and filling an enlarged red cell.
A mature trophozoite is amoeboid with vacuolated cytoplasm and does not fill the whole enlarged cell as a compact round body.
P. ovale gametocytes are smaller within oval, fimbriated host cells; species separation from vivax may require PCR.

64734.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片圈起的大型異常淋巴細胞核膜摺疊呈腦迴狀（cerebriform）、有核仁與中等量藍色細胞質；B–E 圖切片中間質性大細胞群 CD3+、CD4+ 且 CD7 缺失，配合蕈狀肉芽腫病史，代表骨髓侵犯。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells (circled) with deeply folded, convoluted (cerebriform) nuclear contours
Finely granular to vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli; moderate amount of pale-to-medium blue agranular cytoplasm
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells in the aspirate
Core biopsy (H&E) with interstitial clusters of large cells with irregular nuclei
IHC: large cells CD3+ and CD4+ (membranous) with loss of CD7 (only scattered background positivity)
64734.describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate smear (A) contains a population of large atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted, folded (cerebriform) nuclei, fine chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and a moderate amount of agranular cytoplasm, admixed with maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. The core biopsy (B) shows interstitial aggregates of large cells with irregular nuclei in a hypercellular marrow. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells are positive for CD3 (C) and CD4 (D) and show loss of CD7 (E). In a patient with known mycosis fungoides, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by mycosis fungoides with large-cell transformation.

ddx.vs: Sézary syndrome shares CD4+/CD7- cerebriform cells but is defined by erythroderma and a leukemic clone in blood (≥1000/µL Sézary cells or CD4:CD8 ≥10), rather than preceding patch/plaque MF with large-cell transformation.
ATLL cells are CD4+/CD7- but show polylobated 'flower' nuclei, CD25 expression, and HTLV-1 serology positivity.
PTCL NOS may be immunophenotypically similar, so separation depends on clinical history of MF and matching TCR clonality between skin and marrow.
Monocytic cells also have folded nuclei but contain fine azurophilic granules and express CD14/CD68/lysozyme rather than CD3.

64734.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD3, CD4, CD7

64350.recognize_zh: 六張油鏡圖中的中性球細胞質內都可見多個深藍色、短桿狀到球桿狀的細菌（coccobacilli），有的成群或位於空泡內，代表中性球正在吞噬細菌，是菌血症在周邊血抹片的直接證據。
features: Neutrophils and band forms containing multiple intracytoplasmic dark blue short rods/coccobacilli
Organisms clustered within pale or vacuolated cytoplasm, some in small groups
Cytoplasmic vacuolization and toxic changes in affected neutrophils
Occasional band-shaped nuclei consistent with left shift
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes/drying artifact) in thick areas
64350.describe_en: Oil-immersion views of a peripheral blood smear show several neutrophils, including band forms, containing numerous intracytoplasmic dark blue short rods to coccobacilli, some grouped within vacuolated cytoplasm. The neutrophils show toxic vacuolization, and band forms are present. Background red cells are crenated, likely from smear drying. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed bacteria in neutrophils, indicating high-grade bacteremia; correlation with blood culture and Gram stain is required for organism identification.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are round, evenly dispersed purple dots and Dohle bodies are pale blue patches, whereas bacteria are uniform rods or cocci of defined shape, often clustered in vacuoles.
Morulae are single mulberry-like stippled inclusions within a vacuole, rather than multiple discrete rods scattered in the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or contaminant overlying cells
ddx.vs: Precipitate is in a different focal plane and also lies over red cells and background, whereas true phagocytosed bacteria are confined to leukocyte cytoplasm with host vacuoles.
Fungal yeasts are larger oval forms with a clear halo or budding, not slender rods.

64222.recognize_zh: 這是非形態學的血清蛋白毛細管電泳圖：gamma 區出現一個窄而高的尖峰（陰影標示 M Band，2.68 g/dL、占 28.8%），總蛋白 9.31 g/dL、白蛋白偏低，提示單株免疫球蛋白（M 蛋白）。
features: Sebia capillary electrophoresis tracing with a tall, narrow, symmetric spike in the gamma region (shaded, labeled M Band)
M band quantified at 28.8% of total protein, 2.68 g/dL
Total protein 9.31 g/dL; albumin decreased at 3.90 g/dL; A/G ratio 0.72
Gamma fraction increased at 3.41 g/dL; alpha-2 and beta-1 mildly increased
Residual background gamma globulin present on either side of the spike
64222.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic serum protein capillary electrophoresis report. The tracing shows a discrete, narrow, homogeneous peak in the gamma region quantified as an M band of 2.68 g/dL (28.8%), with total protein elevated at 9.31 g/dL, gamma fraction increased at 3.41 g/dL, mildly decreased albumin, and an inverted A/G ratio of 0.72. Findings are consistent with a monoclonal protein; immunofixation is required to determine heavy and light chain type (for example IgM lambda in lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Chronic inflammation, liver disease, or HIV produce a broad-based, diffuse gamma elevation rather than a narrow discrete spike.
Electrophoresis cannot assign isotype; immunofixation showing IgG or IgA rather than IgM, plus marrow clonal plasma cells and CRAB features, distinguishes myeloma.
MGUS has an M protein below 3 g/dL without end-organ damage and less than 10% clonal marrow plasma cells or lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate, so marrow evaluation separates it.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-paraprotein artifact (fibrinogen in plasma, hemolysis, contrast)
ddx.vs: Fibrinogen from an unclotted sample migrates between beta and gamma and is negative on immunofixation.

64158.recognize_zh: 正面胸部 X 光可見上縱膈明顯變寬，縱膈陰影向左側外凸，而兩側肺野相對清楚；年輕病人出現前縱膈腫塊，要想到 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（T-ALL/LBL）。
features: Posteroanterior chest radiograph (photographed from a monitor)
Marked widening of the superior mediastinum with a smooth, lobulated left-sided mediastinal contour
Mediastinal soft-tissue density extends inferiorly along the left heart border
Trachea remains approximately midline; no gross tracheal deviation evident at this resolution
Lung fields largely clear; no large pleural effusion identified
Non-morphologic image: tissue diagnosis is required
64158.describe_en: Posteroanterior chest radiograph demonstrates marked widening of the superior mediastinum, with a smooth, bulging soft-tissue contour projecting predominantly to the left. The lung parenchyma appears largely clear, and no large pleural effusion is evident, although the image is a photograph of a screen and fine detail is limited. Radiology alone cannot establish the cause; in a patient with lymphoblastic leukemia, the finding is consistent with an anterior mediastinal (thymic) mass from T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, which carries a risk of airway and superior vena cava compromise during sedation.

ddx.vs: Also produces an anterior mediastinal mass in young adults; biopsy shows large CD20+/CD23+/PD-L1+ B cells with sclerosis rather than TdT+ CD3+ lymphoblasts.
Distinguished histologically by CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background with fibrous bands.
Separation requires tissue: thymoma shows cytokeratin+ epithelium with immature TdT+ thymocytes that are polyclonal, and germ cell tumors show tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG) and specific IHC.
Cross-sectional imaging (CT) distinguishes a soft-tissue mass from normal thymic tissue or vascular structures.

64030.recognize_zh: 視野中白血球很少，只見一顆小淋巴球與一顆核深染、圓形的有核紅血球（nucleated RBC，正染性紅血球母細胞），紅血球大小形狀不一並有皺縮與不規則碎片狀細胞，符合 MDS 周邊血的血球減少與有核紅血球。
features: Single orthochromatic nucleated red blood cell with a small dense pyknotic nucleus and pale grey-pink cytoplasm
One small mature lymphocyte; no neutrophils or platelets apparent in the field (low-power sparsity suggests cytopenias but cannot be quantified from one field)
Red cell anisopoikilocytosis with oval forms, crenated cells and occasional irregular fragments
Normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor in many cells
No blasts identified in this field
64030.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman stain, high power) shows red cell anisopoikilocytosis with oval forms, crenated cells and occasional irregular fragments. A nucleated red blood cell with a small pyknotic nucleus and a small mature lymphocyte are present, with no neutrophils, platelets or blasts seen in this field. The paucity of leukocytes and platelets is compatible with cytopenias, although this must be confirmed by the complete blood count and multiple fields. In the clinical context of myelodysplastic syndrome, findings are consistent with a cytopenic peripheral blood picture with circulating nucleated red cells.

ddx.vs: Myelophthisis shows nucleated red cells together with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells, whereas MDS shows dysplastic neutrophils (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger) and oval macrocytes.
Megaloblastic anemia features macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils and corrects with B12/folate, rather than hypogranular or hyposegmented neutrophils.
Hemolysis produces nucleated red cells with marked polychromasia and spherocytes or schistocytes, which are not prominent here.

63902.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一顆比一般血小板大的血小板，中央集中紫色顆粒，周圍伸出許多細長絲狀突起（filopodia），呈星芒狀，代表血小板活化早期的形態改變；旁邊另有一顆未活化的小血小板可比較。
features: Platelet with central aggregation of purple granules (granulomere) and pale peripheral hyalomere
Multiple long, thin filamentous cytoplasmic projections (filopodia) radiating from the surface
Larger apparent diameter than an adjacent resting platelet
Background red cells with numerous crenated forms (echinocytes) and a small lymphocyte
63902.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged platelet with centrally clustered granules and numerous long, thin filopodia radiating from its surface, consistent with early platelet activation and shape change. An adjacent smaller platelet retains a resting discoid appearance. The background red cells show numerous echinocytes, likely related to smear preparation, and a small lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with an activated platelet; in isolation this is a nonspecific in vitro phenomenon and should not be interpreted as a platelet disorder.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytic cells contain a nucleus or nuclear fragments, whereas this cell is anucleate with granules only.
Giant platelets are uniformly enlarged, often approach red cell size and lack radiating filopodia.
Hairy cells have a nucleus with ground-glass chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm with fine hair-like projections, unlike this anucleate granular platelet.
These are red cells with short spicules and no purple granules.

63710.recognize_zh: 四格免疫染色中，真皮內瀰漫浸潤的細胞 LCA（CD45）呈淡陽性、lysozyme 強陽性、CD33 呈強的膜／細胞質陽性、CD68 陽性，證明浸潤細胞屬造血系統且具骨髓單核球分化，支持骨髓性肉瘤。
features: Panel A: diffuse, weak to moderate LCA (CD45) staining of the dermal infiltrate
Panel B: strong, diffuse cytoplasmic lysozyme positivity in the neoplastic cells
Panel C: strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD33 positivity throughout the infiltrate
Panel D: moderate granular cytoplasmic CD68 positivity
Infiltrate dissects between pale unstained dermal collagen bundles in all panels
63710.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains performed on the skin punch biopsy show that the diffuse dermal infiltrate is positive for LCA (CD45, relatively weak), lysozyme (strong and diffuse), CD33 (strong, membranous and cytoplasmic) and CD68 (moderate, granular cytoplasmic). The staining is diffuse throughout the tumor cells that dissect between unstained collagen bundles. This profile establishes hematolymphoid origin with myelomonocytic differentiation. In the context of the H&E morphology, findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma with monocytic features.

ddx.vs: BPDCN is CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 positive but typically lysozyme-negative and lacks strong CD33/CD68 myelomonocytic staining.
Lymphomas are CD45 positive but lack lysozyme and CD33 and instead express B- or T-cell lineage markers.
Reactive histiocytes are CD68 and CD163 positive but lack cytologic atypia, CD33 sheets and the destructive diffuse growth of neoplastic cells.
Non-hematopoietic tumors are negative for LCA and myeloid markers and express keratins or S100/SOX10.

63646.recognize_zh: 這是毛細管電泳圖（capillary electrophoresis），可見 Hb A 41.9%、Hb S 54.6%、Hb F 0.4%、Hb A2 3.1% 兩個主峰；Hb S 多於 Hb A，在已知鐮刀型貧血的病人代表輸血後捐血者 Hb A 混入。
features: Capillary electrophoresis tracing with labeled migration zones
Two dominant peaks: Hb A (41.9%) in zone A and Hb S (54.6%) in zone S
Small Hb A2 peak at 3.1% and minimal Hb F at 0.4%
HbS exceeds HbA, a ratio not expected in sickle cell trait
63646.describe_en: Hemoglobin capillary electrophoresis shows two major fractions, Hb A 41.9% and Hb S 54.6%, with Hb A2 3.1% and Hb F 0.4%. The proportion of Hb S exceeds Hb A, which is inconsistent with sickle cell trait, where Hb A normally predominates (Hb S typically below about 40%). In a patient with sickle cell anemia who has recently been transfused, the Hb A represents donor hemoglobin. Findings are consistent with homozygous HbS disease post transfusion; interpretation requires transfusion history, red cell indices and, if needed, HBB genotyping.

ddx.vs: In trait Hb A is the major fraction (about 55-60%) and Hb S is below about 40%, the reverse of this tracing.
HbS/beta+ thalassemia also shows Hb S > Hb A but with microcytosis, low MCV and typically elevated Hb A2 without a history of transfusion.
HbSC shows Hb S and Hb C peaks of roughly equal size with no Hb A.

63582.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：幼兒的手背與腕部明顯腫脹、皮膚緊繃發亮並泛紅，手指也略浮腫；鐮刀型貧血幼童出現這種手足對稱或單側的疼痛性腫脹，應想到小骨梗塞造成的指（趾）炎（hand-foot syndrome）。
features: Young child's hand and distal forearm photographed on a hospital drape
Diffuse swelling of the dorsum of the wrist and hand with tense, shiny skin
Focal erythema over the dorsal wrist region
Mild puffiness of the fingers; no ulceration, pustule or open wound visible
Small superficial abrasions/marks on the swollen skin (possibly cannulation or adhesive sites)
63582.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a young child's hand with diffuse, tense swelling of the dorsum of the wrist and hand, overlying shiny skin, and focal erythema, with mild puffiness of the fingers. There is no visible ulceration, abscess pointing, or necrosis. Clinical photographs cannot distinguish vaso-occlusive infarction from infection, so imaging, inflammatory markers, and blood cultures are needed. In a young child with sickle cell disease, the findings are consistent with dactylitis (hand-foot syndrome) due to vaso-occlusive infarction of the small bones.

ddx.vs: Osteomyelitis is favored by persistent high fever, progressive unilateral focal swelling, positive blood cultures and MRI findings of abscess, and it may coexist with infarction.
Cellulitis shows spreading warm erythema with a skin portal of entry and fluctuance on exam rather than primarily bony-origin symmetric swelling.
JIA causes joint-centered swelling lasting more than 6 weeks without the acute self-limited course of sickle dactylitis.
Extravasation swelling is localized to a recent IV site with a clear temporal relationship to infusion.

63518.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中大部分紅血球含有環狀或不規則的寄生蟲，許多紅血球含多個蟲體，背景還有成群的紅血球外寄生蟲（extracellular forms），無色素與配子體，符合重度巴貝西蟲感染（severe babesiosis）。
features: High parasite burden with a large proportion of red cells infected
Pleomorphic ring forms, dot forms, and elongated/amoeboid intraerythrocytic parasites
Multiply infected red cells
Clusters of extracellular parasites in the background
No hemozoin pigment or gametocytes; infected red cells not enlarged
Red cell clumping/overlap in this thick area of the smear limits single-cell assessment
63518.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased parasite burden, with many red cells containing pleomorphic ring, dot, and elongated intraerythrocytic parasites, frequently more than one per cell. Numerous extracellular parasites are present in small clusters in the background, while hemozoin pigment, schizonts, and gametocytes are absent. Red cell overlap in this area limits assessment of individual cells, and parasitemia should be counted in a thin monolayer area. Findings are consistent with severe babesiosis with high parasitemia; levels above 10% are an indication to consider red cell exchange transfusion.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum shows uniform rings with accolé forms, pigment in late stages, and crescent gametocytes, and extracellular parasites are uncommon, whereas Babesia shows pleomorphic rings and frequent extracellular clusters.
Platelet clumps are granular aggregates without discrete ring structures and do not appear inside red cells.
Bacteria are uniform rods or cocci and precipitate is crystalline, neither showing chromatin dots with ring-shaped cytoplasm.
Trypanosomes are extracellular, much larger flagellated organisms with an undulating membrane and kinetoplast.

63326.recognize_zh: 兩個小型淋巴球核濃密均質，右上那顆的淡藍胞質中可見彎曲、互相交錯的細絲狀包涵體（filamentous inclusions），在 CLL 背景下這是免疫球蛋白結晶類包涵體的表現。
features: Small to medium mature lymphocytes with dense, homogeneous, deeply staining nuclei
Irregular/angular nuclear outlines; nucleoli not prominent
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing curvilinear, interlacing filamentous inclusions
Inclusions are pale, non-refractile and occupy part of the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Background with numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) and scattered platelets
63326.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense homogeneous chromatin and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm. One lymphocyte contains curvilinear, interlacing filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, and the second shows a subtler inclusion. The background red cells are crenated. In a patient with known CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells bearing filamentous (likely immunoglobulin-related crystalline) intracytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with CD103/CD11c/CD25 positivity, not internal filaments.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / plasmacytoid lymphocytes with Russell or Dutcher-type inclusions
ddx.vs: LPL inclusions are usually round globules rather than wavy filaments, and flow shows CD5-negative clonal B cells with an IgM paraprotein.
Reactive lymphocytes show basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells without filamentous inclusions and are polyclonal.

63262.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式雙參數圖：紅色主要族群位於右下象限，CD3 明亮陽性、CD56 大多陰性（僅少數延伸至弱陽性），綠色為 CD3 表現略弱的背景 T 細胞，左側藍點為 CD3 陰性的 B/NK 細胞；表示擴增的族群為 T 細胞系（sCD3+），支持 T-LGL 而非 NK 細胞增生。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD56 PE-Cy7 (y-axis) vs CD3 PerCP-Cy5.5 (x-axis)
Dominant red population in Q4: bright CD3 expression, predominantly CD56 negative
Minor tail of the red population extending into dim CD56 positivity (Q2)
Green background T cells with slightly lower CD3 intensity, some CD56-positive
Light-blue CD3-negative events, a subset CD56-positive (NK cells), reduced in number
63262.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes shows CD56 (y-axis) versus CD3 (x-axis). The predominant population (red) expresses bright surface CD3 and is largely CD56-negative, with only a minor subset extending into dim CD56 positivity. Background T cells (green) show slightly dimmer CD3, and a small CD3-negative population (blue) includes scattered CD56-positive NK cells. The expanded population is of T-cell lineage, which, together with LGL morphology and gamma/delta TCR expression on companion plots, is consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGL proliferations are surface CD3-negative and usually CD56-positive, the opposite of the bright CD3+ population shown here.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive and EBV-associated with a fulminant course.

Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma is CD3+ and typically CD56-positive with gamma/delta TCR, but shows sinusoidal marrow/splenic infiltration and a clinically aggressive picture rather than indolent LGL lymphocytosis.

63198.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片幾乎全是卵圓形紅血球（ovalocyte），部分略大，許多細胞中央淡染區呈橫向、偏心或縱向的裂隙狀口形（stoma），還有 Y 形裂隙；卵圓形加口形紅血球的組合，是東南亞卵圓形紅血球症（SAO）的特徵。
features: Majority of red cells oval, many broad and slightly macrocytic (macro-ovalocytes), well hemoglobinized
Numerous stomatocytic ovalocytes with slit-like stomas oriented transversely (blue arrow), off-center (green arrow) or longitudinally (black arrow)
Y-shaped stoma (red arrow) and some cells with more than one stoma
No prominent spherocytes, fragments, target cells or polychromasia
Unremarkable segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets
63198.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominance of oval red cells, many broad and slightly larger than normal (macro-ovalocytes). Many ovalocytes contain slit-like stomas that are transverse (blue arrow), off-center (green arrow), longitudinal (black arrow) or Y-shaped (red arrow), and some cells have more than one stoma. Spherocytes, fragmented cells and polychromasia are not prominent, and the neutrophil and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Southeast Asian ovalocytosis; confirmation is by detection of the 27-bp deletion in SLC4A1 (band 3).

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are elongated with parallel sides and lack stomatocytic slits; the defect is usually in spectrin or protein 4.1.
Stomatocytes are round rather than oval with a single mouth-like slit, often with macrocytosis, hemolysis and abnormal cation permeability.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or thalassemia with elliptocytes
ddx.vs: Cells are microcytic and hypochromic with pencil cells and target cells, without stomas.
Artifactual slits are confined to thick smear areas in round cells, whereas SAO stomas occur in uniformly oval cells throughout the monolayer.

63134.recognize_zh: Lambda 輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）中，散在許多藍黑色陽性漿細胞，數量與 kappa 染色相當，表示漿細胞為多株性（polytypic），支持反應性背景而非淋巴瘤。
features: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain mRNA (blue chromogen) on tissue, low power
Numerous scattered lambda-positive plasma cells, singly and in loose clusters
Positive cells distributed through a fibrous and adipose-containing stroma
Numbers comparable to, though somewhat fewer than, kappa-positive cells on the paired stain
Background histiocytes and stroma are negative
63134.describe_en: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain shows numerous scattered and loosely clustered positive plasma cells throughout the lesion. Compared with the paired kappa stain, the kappa:lambda ratio is within the polytypic range, without evidence of light-chain restriction. The large histiocytes and stroma are negative. Findings indicate a polytypic plasma cell population, supporting a reactive plasmacytic component as seen in extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows light-chain restricted plasma cells (kappa:lambda markedly skewed) with a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate, unlike the polytypic plasma cells of RDD.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of monotypic plasma cells, without the S100+ emperipolesis-rich histiocytes of RDD.
IgG4-RD also has polytypic plasma cells but shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.

63006.recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩群共五個大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，其中數個細胞核內有邊界清楚的淡染凹陷，像杯口或魚嘴（cup-like nuclear invagination）；背景還有塗抹破裂的細胞殘骸。杯狀核母細胞是 NPM1 合併 FLT3-ITD 突變 AML 的形態線索。
features: Two small groups of large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Pale, well-defined cup-like (fish-mouth) nuclear invaginations in several blasts
Scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Elongated smudged/crushed cell remnant in the center of the field
Red cells with refractile drying artifact; phone-camera photograph limits nucleolar detail
63006.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows two groups of large blasts with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm, several of which contain well-defined pale cup-like nuclear invaginations. Auer rods are not seen, and a smudged cell remnant is present. Red cells show refractile drying artifact, and the photograph limits assessment of nucleoli. In the setting of marked leukocytosis with about 85% circulating blasts, the findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia, raising the possibility of NPM1-mutated AML with FLT3-ITD; flow cytometry, cytogenetics and molecular testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed or butterfly nuclei, may show Auer rod bundles, and carry PML::RARA, whereas cup-like blasts have round nuclei with a single indentation.
Promonocytes have delicately folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant gray cytoplasm and vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase-positive.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and TdT-positive, whereas cup-like AML is typically CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative with MPO positivity.

62942.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片可見兩個界線不清、以淡染組織球為主並夾雜小淋巴球的間質性結節，周圍骨髓有正常造血與巨核細胞；結節看起來像肉芽腫，是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤在骨髓中容易被忽略的樣子。
features: Two ill-defined interstitial nodules composed of pale histiocytes and small lymphocytes
Histiocytes impart a pale, loosely textured appearance to the nodules
Scattered small dark lymphocytes; large atypical cells not discernible at this magnification
Surrounding marrow shows multilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and fat
Adjacent vessel with proteinaceous fluid; no necrosis
62942.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E section of a bone marrow core biopsy shows two ill-defined interstitial nodules rich in pale histiocytes admixed with small lymphocytes. The surrounding marrow shows multilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and fat, without necrosis. Large atypical cells are not readily appreciated at this magnification, so the nodules could be mistaken for granulomas or benign aggregates. Immunohistochemistry demonstrating scattered large CD20+/OCT2+ B cells in a CD3-rich background supports T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Granulomas are tighter epithelioid aggregates, may have giant cells, and lack scattered atypical large B cells on IHC.
Benign aggregates are compact, lymphocyte-dominant, and not histiocyte-rich.
cHL in marrow usually shows fibrosis with a mixed infiltrate including eosinophils and CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells.

62878.recognize_zh: 低倍下多片大腸黏膜切片的固有層被瀰漫性、密集的淋巴浸潤撐開，腺窩被推開但仍保留，部分片段幾乎整片被淋巴細胞取代，未見潰瘍或大面積壞死。
features: Multiple mucosal biopsy fragments at scanning magnification
Diffuse, dense expansion of the lamina propria by a basophilic cellular infiltrate
Crypts spread apart but retained, without marked architectural destruction
Some fragments almost completely replaced by the infiltrate
No ulceration, necrosis or nodular follicular pattern evident at this power
62878.describe_en: Low-power H&E sections of multiple colonic mucosal biopsy fragments show diffuse expansion of the lamina propria by a dense cellular infiltrate that separates but does not destroy the crypts; some fragments are almost entirely composed of the infiltrate. No ulceration, necrosis or follicular architecture is evident at this magnification. Higher-power cytology and immunophenotyping are needed; in this case the pattern is consistent with mucosal involvement by indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma often shows reactive follicles with colonized germinal centers and lymphoepithelial lesions, and is CD20-positive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or follicular lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: These B-cell lymphomas tend to form nodular or follicular patterns and express CD20 with cyclin D1 or CD10/BCL2.
IBD shows crypt distortion, basal plasmacytosis and cryptitis with a polymorphous infiltrate.

62750.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現大量小而圓、染色質濃密的有核紅血球（NRBC），數量甚至多於白血球，並伴隨淚滴狀紅血球與不成熟骨髓系細胞，符合骨髓纖維化的白血球-幼紅血球（leukoerythroblastic）血像。
features: Numerous nucleated red blood cells with small round, dense pyknotic nuclei and a rim of hemoglobinized cytoplasm
Immature myeloid cell with granular cytoplasm and a larger cell with high N:C ratio (possible blast/promyelocyte) in the center
Red cells with poikilocytosis including teardrop and elongated forms
Many red cells show refractile crenated rims and pale centers from drying artifact
Platelet fragments present
62750.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating nucleated red blood cells with small dense round nuclei, outnumbering other nucleated cells in this field, together with immature granulocytic cells. Red cells show poikilocytosis including teardrop forms, and many display refractile drying artifact. Platelet fragments are present. The leukoerythroblastic picture with marked normoblastemia is consistent with marrow fibrosis in post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis; nucleated red cells must be excluded from the automated WBC count to avoid spurious leukocytosis.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and less pyknotic chromatin, whereas NRBCs have pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm and very dense round nuclei.
Hemolysis shows polychromasia and spherocytes or other hemolytic red cell shapes without immature myeloid cells and teardrop cells.
Marrow infiltration can produce the same leukoerythroblastic picture; distinction requires bone marrow biopsy.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows circulating erythroid precursors that are proerythroblasts with basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm rather than mature orthochromic NRBCs.

62686.recognize_zh: 高倍 Ki-67 染色下，約四到五成的細胞核呈棕色陽性，陽性細胞平均散布、沒有反應性生發中心常見的明暗區極性（polarization），表示這是增殖指數偏高的濾泡性淋巴瘤區域。
features: Dense sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells at high power
Nuclear Ki-67 positivity in roughly 40-50% of cells with variable intensity
Positive cells evenly distributed without zonal polarization
Negative cells have small round to slightly irregular nuclei
Follicle borders not discernible in this field
62686.describe_en: High-power Ki-67 immunohistochemistry shows a dense population of small to medium lymphoid cells with nuclear staining in approximately 40-50% of cells. The positive cells are evenly distributed without the polarized dark-zone/light-zone pattern expected in reactive germinal centers. Follicle boundaries are not visible in this field, so the estimate applies to the area shown. A proliferation index of this level is higher than typical for low-grade follicular lymphoma and should prompt correlation with centroblast counts for grading or exclusion of a diffuse large B-cell component. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with a relatively high proliferation index.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers have a very high Ki-67 index (often >90%) with polarization toward the dark zone and a sharp drop in the mantle zone.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows diffuse sheets of large centroblast-like cells, usually with a higher Ki-67 index, without a follicular pattern on low power.
Typically has a low Ki-67 index (<20-30%) evenly spread through the follicles.

62622.recognize_zh: 低倍下積液細胞塊的粉紅色蛋白質／纖維蛋白背景中，有一大團密集的藍紫色大型細胞群，周圍僅散在少數游離細胞，沒有腺體或乳突結構；這團單一形態的大細胞提示積液中的淋巴瘤，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Dense aggregate of monotonous large atypical cells within fibrinous material
Cells appear discohesive at the edges with scattered single cells in the surrounding background
Round nuclei with visible nucleoli even at low power
Abundant eosinophilic proteinaceous/fibrinous background with fresh hemorrhage
No gland formation, papillae or mesothelial sheets identified
62622.describe_en: Cell block of effusion fluid at low power shows abundant eosinophilic proteinaceous and fibrinous material containing a large cellular aggregate of monotonous atypical cells, with additional single cells scattered in the background. The cells are large with round nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli, and there is no glandular, papillary or mesothelial architecture. Detailed cytology is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a high-grade lymphoid neoplasm in the effusion and, with supportive immunophenotyping and HHV8 LANA-1 positivity, consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Adenocarcinoma aggregates are cohesive with acinar or papillary formations and cytoplasmic vacuoles and are keratin/MOC31 positive, unlike the discohesive CD45+/CD138+ PEL cells.
Reactive effusions contain predominantly small mature lymphocytes and macrophages rather than monotonous large cells with prominent nucleoli.
Fibrin-associated DLBCL is EBV+ but HHV8-negative, typically arises in cysts, pseudocysts or prosthetic devices and expresses B-cell markers.

62558.recognize_zh: 中倍下單調、中等大小的腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫片狀，在粉紅色纖維／肌肉束之間浸潤生長，其間散布許多含吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞形成星空樣（starry sky）；需以 FISH 確認 MYC 與 BCL2 重排。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio
Scattered tingible-body macrophages producing a starry-sky pattern
Infiltration between and dissecting dense eosinophilic fibromuscular bundles
Numerous apoptotic bodies; no residual nodal or follicular architecture in the field
62558.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, highly cellular infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells that dissects between thick eosinophilic fibromuscular bundles. The tumor cells have scant cytoplasm and a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and numerous scattered tingible-body macrophages impart a starry-sky appearance. No residual normal architecture is identified in this field. The findings indicate an aggressive B-cell lymphoma with high proliferative activity; the differential includes Burkitt lymphoma and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, and FISH is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Burkitt also shows a starry sky but is BCL2-negative with MYC rearrangement alone, whereas double-hit lymphoma is typically BCL2-positive with both MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.
DLBCL usually has larger, more pleomorphic cells and lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements on FISH.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finely dispersed blastic chromatin and is TdT-positive.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive.

62494.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色中，黑色纖維在多數細胞周圍形成緻密交錯的網絡，瀰漫全視野，代表網狀纖維明顯增加，是 CML 加速期伴隨巨核細胞增生時可見的骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse, dense network of black-staining reticulin fibers outlining most individual cells
Extensive fiber intersections throughout the field, well beyond perivascular foci
Hypercellular marrow with scattered megakaryocytes visible as larger pink cells
Thick coarse collagen bundles not clearly identified; trichrome would be needed to assess collagen
62494.describe_en: Reticulin stain on a bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections enveloping most hematopoietic cells, approximately MF-2 or higher on the WHO grading system; grading is best confirmed at lower power across the entire core. Thick collagen bundles cannot be reliably assessed on this stain. Marrow fibrosis in CML is associated with megakaryocytic proliferation and more advanced disease, and it may regress with tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.

ddx.vs: PMF shows similar fibrosis but with atypical clustered megakaryocytes with cloud-like nuclei, osteosclerosis and a BCR::ABL1-negative JAK2/CALR/MPL-driven clone.
Post-PV myelofibrosis follows documented polycythemia vera with a JAK2 mutation and lacks BCR::ABL1.
HCL also produces diffuse reticulin fibrosis but with evenly spaced cells having a fried-egg appearance and CD20/annexin A1 positivity.

62430.recognize_zh: 整個視野是一片大小均一、緊密排列的腫瘤細胞，細胞膜呈均勻一致的 CD19 棕色陽性，僅夾雜少數染色陰性的空白區（對應 starry-sky 的巨噬細胞與血管）——表示腫瘤為 B 細胞來源，符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤的免疫表型之一。
features: Diffuse sheet of densely packed, monotonous tumor cells
Strong, uniform membranous CD19 staining in virtually all tumor cells
Scattered small negative pale areas corresponding to tingible-body macrophages and vessels
No nodular or follicular architecture evident at this power
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification
62430.describe_en: CD19 immunostain shows a diffuse sheet of monotonous, densely packed tumor cells with strong, uniform membranous positivity. Scattered unstained pale spaces are present, corresponding to interspersed macrophages and vessels of a starry-sky pattern. No residual follicular architecture is appreciated. Findings confirm a B-cell lineage neoplasm; together with CD10/BCL6 positivity, BCL2 negativity, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement, this supports Burkitt lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are also CD19-positive, so separation relies on cytology, BCL2 expression, Ki-67 below near-100% and MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma is CD19-positive but TdT-positive and surface-immunoglobulin-negative, unlike Burkitt lymphoma.
T-cell neoplasms would be CD19-negative and CD3-positive.
Myeloid sarcoma is typically CD19-negative (except t(8;21)-associated cases) and expresses MPO, CD33 or CD117.

62366.recognize_zh: CD20 染色下外套層與生發中心皆為 B 細胞而呈棕色陽性，擴張的外套層形成大片一致的陽性區，只有濾泡間的纖細條帶為陰性（T 細胞區），標示出外套層擴張的範圍。
features: Diffuse membranous CD20 staining of large nodular areas corresponding to expanded mantle zones
Germinal centers also CD20-positive, with slightly larger cells and stronger staining
Thin CD20-negative interfollicular bands representing T-cell zones and vessels
Nodular architecture with near-confluence of adjacent nodules
62366.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of nearly all cells within large nodules composed of expanded mantle zones and their residual germinal centers, separated by thin CD20-negative interfollicular septa. The B-cell population thus accounts for the mantle zone expansion. Although CD20 does not discriminate neoplastic from reactive B cells, in conjunction with CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 co-expression the findings support mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone pattern.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are CD10+ BCL2+ in germinal-center-like nodules and are CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
Reactive follicles have normal-width polarized mantles with polytypic B cells lacking CD5 and cyclin D1.
MZL shows CD20+ perifollicular marginal zone expansion but is CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.

62302.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一個單核球的細胞質內有一個清楚的吞噬空泡，空泡內含一顆紫紅色顆粒狀的血小板，背景紅血球有許多棘狀/鋸齒狀變形，這種周邊血單核球吞噬血小板的現象可作為噬血症候群（HLH）的線索。
features: Single monocyte with a folded, eccentric nucleus and moderately abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Well-defined cytoplasmic phagocytic vacuole containing an engulfed granular platelet
Background red cells with numerous crenated/spiculated forms (acanthocytes and echinocytes)
Occasional fragmented or irregular red cells
Few platelets in the background, in keeping with thrombocytopenia
62302.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monocyte with a folded eccentric nucleus and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing a well-circumscribed phagocytic vacuole with an engulfed granular platelet. The background red cells show numerous spiculated forms, including acanthocytes and echinocytes, with occasional irregular fragments, and free platelets are sparse. Although red cell crenation may partly reflect film preparation, the platelet phagocytosis is genuine intracellular engulfment rather than an overlying platelet. In the clinical context of fever, cytopenias and hyperferritinemia, the finding supports hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: An overlying platelet lies on the cell surface without a surrounding clear vacuole, whereas this platelet sits within a defined phagocytic vacuole.
Organisms show a halo with a small eccentric nucleus/kinetoplast and are usually multiple, whereas this inclusion is a single granular platelet.

ddx.dx: Monocyte with ingested cryoglobulin or debris
ddx.vs: Cryoglobulin inclusions are homogeneous and amorphous blue-violet rather than granular with a platelet's purple granulomere.
Sepsis-related phagocytosis usually involves bacteria in neutrophils, while here a monocyte contains a platelet.

62174.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為核質開放、可見核仁、細胞質淡灰的母細胞；周圍紅系前驅細胞染色質粗塊狀，部分呈雙核或核出芽，母細胞與紅系發育不良並存，符合 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Arrow indicates a blast with open chromatin, visible nucleolus and pale grey agranular cytoplasm
Numerous additional blast-like cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with coarse clumped chromatin, including binucleate forms and nuclear budding
Granulocytic precursors with cytoplasmic granules; occasional eosinophil at bottom
Hypercellular smear with red cells in background
62174.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population containing increased blasts, one of which is highlighted by the arrow and shows open chromatin, a visible nucleolus and pale agranular cytoplasm. Numerous erythroid precursors with coarse chromatin are present, some with binucleation and nuclear budding indicating dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic precursors and an eosinophil are also seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes, subject to blast enumeration and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: MDS-IB shows the same dysplasia but with blasts <20%, requiring a formal blast count to separate from AML.

ddx.dx: AML with defining genetic abnormality (e.g. NPM1-mutated AML)
ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia can occur in NPM1- or biallelic CEBPA-mutated AML, which take precedence over myelodysplasia-related classification by molecular testing.
Morphology is similar, and the distinction relies on a history of prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation.

62046.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色下，一個模糊的大結節內有大量陽性小淋巴球，並可見多個由陽性細胞圍成的環狀結構包住中央未染色的大細胞（rosettes），這種包圍 LP 細胞的 T 細胞環是 NLPHL 的特徵線索。
features: Vague large nodule with increased density of positive small lymphocytes compared with the surrounding zone
Multiple ring-like rosettes of positive cells encircling larger unstained central cells within the nodule
Membranous red chromogen staining of small lymphocytes; negative background small lymphocytes outside the nodule
Scattered positive cells in the internodular areas and around small vessels
Specific antibody not labeled; the rosetting pattern is typical of PD-1 or CD57 T follicular helper cells
62046.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low-to-medium power shows a vaguely nodular area containing an increased density of positive small lymphocytes. Within the nodule, positive small cells form multiple ring-like rosettes surrounding larger unstained cells, a pattern characteristic of T follicular helper cells (PD-1/CD57) rimming LP cells. Scattered positive cells are also present in the internodular zone. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; the specific marker should be confirmed from the case record and LP cells highlighted with CD20, PAX5, OCT2 or BOB1.

ddx.vs: PTGC nodules contain mantle-type small B cells with residual germinal center cells but lack LP cells ringed by PD-1+/CD57+ rosettes.
THRLBCL is diffuse with scattered large B cells in a CD8+ T-cell and histiocyte background that usually lacks residual follicular dendritic meshworks and PD-1+ rosettes.
LRCHL can show T-cell rosettes, but its HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and weak/negative for PAX5 with loss of OCT2/BOB1, unlike CD20+ LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma nodules are composed of neoplastic BCL2+ centrocytes and centroblasts without scattered large LP cells rimmed by rosettes.

61918.recognize_zh: CD3免疫染色下，固有層內幾乎所有浸潤細胞都呈強陽性，將陰性腺體包圍隔開；NK細胞腸病的NK細胞表面CD3陰性，但用多株CD3ε抗體染石蠟切片時會呈細胞質陽性，所以單看此圖不能據以診斷為T細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse strong CD3 staining of the dense lamina propria infiltrate
Positive medium-sized cells encircle and separate negative glands
Staining appears both membranous and cytoplasmic; surface versus cytoplasmic localization cannot be resolved at this power
Minimal intraepithelial CD3-positive cells; no gland destruction
61918.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry on gastrointestinal mucosa shows diffuse strong staining of a dense infiltrate of medium-sized cells expanding the lamina propria between CD3-negative glands. Intraepithelial positivity is limited, and glands are preserved. Because paraffin CD3 antibodies detect the cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon chain expressed by NK cells, this pattern does not by itself establish T-cell lineage. With CD56 positivity, CD5 negativity, lack of TCR clonality and EBER negativity, the findings support NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: MEITL shows CD3-positive cells with striking epitheliotropism and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas this infiltrate spares the epithelium and would be TCR non-clonal.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Indolent T-LPD expresses surface CD3 with CD5 and CD4 or CD8, lacks CD56 and shows clonal TCR.
ENKTL shares cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon expression but is EBER-positive with necrosis and angiodestruction.

61854.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中看到成束排列的梭形細胞病灶（A、B），乍看像間質腫瘤，但 CD138、CD38、MUM1 與 kappa 皆彌漫陽性（D–G），證實這些梭形細胞其實是單株性漿細胞；網狀纖維染色（H）顯示纖維增加。
features: Fascicles of spindle-shaped cells with elongated, cigar-shaped nuclei in the marrow (H&E)
Moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm without obvious plasmacytoid features at high power
Aspirate smear with numerous dispersed cells, limited morphologic detail at this magnification
Diffuse membranous CD138 and CD38 and nuclear MUM1 positivity in the spindle cells
Kappa light-chain restriction by IHC
Increased reticulin fiber network
61854.describe_en: Composite bone marrow biopsy and aspirate figure. The core biopsy (A, B) shows a sheet-like lesion composed of fascicles of spindle cells with elongated nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, mimicking a mesenchymal neoplasm; the aspirate (C) is cellular but lacks detail at this magnification. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates that the spindle cells are diffusely positive for CD138 (D), CD38 (E), and MUM1 (F), with kappa light-chain expression (G), and reticulin stain (H) shows increased fibrosis. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma) with unusual spindle cell morphology.

ddx.vs: A true sarcoma would be negative for CD138, MUM1, and light chains, whereas here the spindle cells are plasma-cell lineage and kappa restricted.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with spindled mast cells
ddx.vs: Spindled mast cells are tryptase/CD117 positive with CD25 aberrancy and are negative for CD138 and immunoglobulin light chains.
Fibrotic MPN shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reactive stroma rather than a monotypic CD138+/kappa+ spindle population.
Metastatic tumors express keratin or S100/SOX10 and lack plasma-cell markers and light-chain restriction.

61854.stain: H&E, Wright-Giemsa, IHC: CD138, CD38, MUM1, kappa; reticulin

61790.recognize_zh: 整個視野的紅血球大小差異極大、多呈淚滴狀（黃色箭頭）且中央淡染明顯（hypochromia），夾雜標靶細胞與碎片；配合臨床的小球性貧血與電泳 HbH，才指向 HbH disease。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells (dacrocytes), several with long tails (arrows)
Microcytic, hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor
Scattered target cells, elongated/pencil forms, and small red cell fragments
Occasional larger, more uniformly staining red cell (possible polychromatic cell)
Platelets present, including a small clump; no nucleated cells in this field
Wright stain does not show HbH inclusions, which require supravital (brilliant cresyl blue) staining
61790.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly abnormal red cell population with severe anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Red cells are predominantly microcytic and hypochromic, with numerous teardrop cells, target cells, elongated forms and fragments. Platelets appear adequate, and no nucleated red cells or abnormal leukocytes are present in this field. HbH (beta-4 tetramer) inclusions are not assessable on a Romanowsky stain. In the context of microcytosis and an HbH fraction on capillary electrophoresis, the findings are consistent with HbH disease; prominent dacrocytosis is otherwise nonspecific and a marrow infiltrative process should be excluded clinically if other features are discordant.

ddx.vs: Shows similar microcytic poikilocytosis with teardrops and targets but usually more nucleated red cells and basophilic stippling, with raised HbF/HbA2 rather than an HbH band.
Teardrop cells there accompany a leukoerythroblastic picture with immature granulocytes and NRBCs, and red cells are not uniformly microcytic-hypochromic.
Produces hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells but fewer targets and teardrops, with low ferritin and no HbH on electrophoresis or supravital stain.
Features microspherocytes, budding and extreme fragmentation with very low MCV but normal hemoglobin electrophoresis and abnormal spectrin studies.

61726.recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD36 對 CD64 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 CD36 陽性但 CD64 陰性，而少量紅色事件有 CD64 表現；BPDCN 常表現 CD36，但缺乏 CD64 可幫忙與單核球性白血病區分。
features: Dot plot: CD36-FITC (x-axis) versus CD64-PE (y-axis), gated on blasts
Abnormal population (green) CD36-positive (moderate) and CD64-negative
Red events mostly CD36-negative/dim with a subset showing partial CD64 expression
Sparse CD36+/CD64+ red events consistent with residual monocytic cells
Absence of a coordinated CD64-bright/CD36-bright monocytic cluster in the abnormal population
61726.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD36 versus CD64 gated on blasts shows the abnormal population (green) to be CD36-positive and CD64-negative. Red events are predominantly CD36-negative to dim with partial CD64 expression, and rare CD36/CD64 double-positive events likely represent residual monocytic cells. CD36 is frequently expressed by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, whereas lack of CD64 helps distinguish it from monocytic leukemia, which is usually CD64 and CD36 co-positive. This profile is compatible with BPDCN in conjunction with CD4, CD56 and bright CD123 expression.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts are typically CD64-bright together with CD36, CD11b and CD14, unlike this CD64-negative population.
These can be CD36-positive but express CD71/CD235a or CD41/CD61 and lack CD4/CD56/CD123-bright.

61662.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中可見多個大型、核高度分葉（hyperlobated）且大小不一的巨核細胞聚集成群，背景為紅血球系與顆粒球系增生、脂肪減少，符合真性紅血球增多症（PV）增生期的全髓增生（panmyelosis）。
features: Clusters of enlarged, pleomorphic megakaryocytes with hyperlobated, deeply folded nuclei
Megakaryocytes vary markedly in size; no small hypolobated (micro)megakaryocytes seen
Abundant erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and granulocytic precursors (panmyelosis)
Reduced fat with dilated sinusoids and extravasated red cells
No excess of blasts or obvious reticulin-type fibrosis appreciable on H&E
61662.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hyperplasia. Megakaryocytes are increased, form loose clusters, and are large and pleomorphic with hyperlobulated nuclei. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors are abundant and show orderly maturation, without an increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm, in keeping with polycythemia vera in the proliferative phase given the clinical and JAK2 context.

ddx.vs: ET shows clusters of large, hyperlobated 'staghorn' megakaryocytes on a normocellular background without the erythroid and granulocytic panmyelosis seen here.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like, hypolobated nuclei and tight clusters, rather than the large hyperlobated but maturely formed nuclei in PV.
Reactive erythrocytosis lacks megakaryocytic clustering and pleomorphism, and is JAK2-negative with appropriate EPO elevation.
CML shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1, unlike the large hyperlobated megakaryocytes here.

61598.recognize_zh: CD45 染色下，大多數腫瘤細胞呈陰性（只有藍色核），而散在的小淋巴球呈強烈環狀膜染色作為內部陽性對照；淋巴瘤細胞 CD45 陰性或弱陽性，是漿母細胞淋巴瘤與漿細胞腫瘤的特點。
features: Sheets of medium to large tumor cells lacking membranous CD45 staining
Scattered small reactive lymphocytes with strong circumferential membranous CD45 (internal control)
Faint granular background/interstitial staining not localized to tumor cell membranes
Tumor nuclei round with visible nucleoli in the hematoxylin counterstain
61598.describe_en: CD45 (LCA) immunostain shows the neoplastic large cells to be negative, while admixed small reactive lymphocytes display strong membranous staining that serves as an internal positive control. Faint granular background staining is present but is not membranous on tumor cells. Loss or weak expression of CD45 is typical of plasmablastic lymphoma and plasma cell neoplasms. In combination with CD20 negativity and MUM1/EBER positivity, the findings support EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CD45 negativity also occurs in non-hematopoietic tumors, which are excluded by keratin or S100/SOX10 staining and absence of MUM1/CD138 with EBER.
Myeloma cells are likewise CD45 negative, so separation depends on clinical CRAB features, M-protein and EBER status rather than CD45.
ALCL may also be CD45 negative but shows strong uniform CD30 with T-cell antigens or ALK, not a plasmacytic immunophenotype.

61534.recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片單調的小至中型細胞，核多呈有稜角、扭曲或有裂溝的形狀（centrocyte），僅偶見核較大、染色質較開放的 centroblast；左側可見殘存的腺上皮，符合低級別濾泡性淋巴瘤浸潤十二指腸黏膜。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphoid cells
Predominantly angulated, elongated, and cleaved nuclei (centrocytes) with dense chromatin
Only occasional larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli (centroblasts)
Scant pale cytoplasm; no plasmacytic or monocytoid differentiation
Residual glandular epithelium at the left edge; no tingible body macrophages seen
61534.describe_en: High-power view of the duodenal biopsy shows a monotonous infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. Most cells have angulated, elongated, or cleaved nuclei with condensed chromatin, consistent with centrocytes, while larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin are infrequent. Tingible body macrophages, mitotic activity, and sheets of large cells are not appreciated, and residual glandular epithelium is present at the edge. In conjunction with a CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2+ immunophenotype, findings are consistent with low-grade (duodenal-type) follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain a mixture of centroblasts and centrocytes with tingible body macrophages and frequent mitoses, and are BCL2 negative.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells have slightly irregular but less angulated nuclei, lack centroblasts, and are cyclin D1+/CD5+ rather than CD10+.
MALT lymphoma cells have more cytoplasm (monocytoid), plasmacytic differentiation, and lymphoepithelial lesions, and are CD10/BCL6 negative.
DLBCL is composed of sheets of large cells (centroblasts or immunoblasts), unlike the predominantly small cleaved cells here.

61470.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中大量大小正常的紅血球內含細小環狀體，常一顆紅血球內有 2–4 個環、雙染色質點與貼邊（appliqué）型；中央可見香蕉形（新月形）配子體兩個重疊於同一紅血球，這些組合是惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: High parasitemia of delicate small ring forms in normal-sized red cells without enlargement or Schüffner stippling
Multiple rings within single erythrocytes (up to 3-4), double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué (accolé) forms
Crescent (banana-shaped) gametocytes: two overlapping within one red cell centrally, another at the right edge
No mature trophozoites or schizonts seen in peripheral blood
Segmented neutrophil and scattered platelet clumps in background
61470.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows numerous erythrocytes infected by small, delicate ring-form trophozoites; infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner dots. Many cells contain multiple rings, including rings with double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué forms. Crescent-shaped gametocytes are present, including two overlapping gametocytes within a single erythrocyte. No mature trophozoites or schizonts are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with high parasitemia; percent parasitemia should be quantified and reported urgently.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, show ameboid trophozoites and schizonts, and have round rather than crescent gametocytes.
Knowlesi rings can mimic falciparum but lack crescent gametocytes and show band-form trophozoites and schizonts in blood.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets lack a ring-shaped cytoplasm with a chromatin dot and sit in a different focal plane.

61342.recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球的核只分成兩個圓形核葉、以細絲相連（夾鼻眼鏡狀，pince-nez），染色質粗塊狀聚集，細胞質淡而顆粒稀少，符合假性 Pelger-Huët（Pelgeroid）變化。
features: Mature-sized neutrophil with bilobed nucleus: two round lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand (pince-nez configuration)
Coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with markedly reduced specific granules (hypogranularity)
Background erythrocytes unremarkable; a single platelet nearby
61342.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a hyposegmented bilobed nucleus in a pince-nez configuration, coarse chromatin clumping and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. Red cells in the field show no significant abnormality. In an acquired setting, these findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët (Pelgeroid) change, a dysgranulopoietic feature that should prompt evaluation for a myelodysplastic neoplasm or drug effect.

ddx.vs: Inherited LBR-related anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation, whereas pseudo-Pelger cells are a subpopulation often accompanied by hypogranularity and other dysplasia.
Band forms have a continuous U-shaped nucleus of uniform width without a thin filament separating discrete round lobes, and granulation is normal.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced Pelgeroid change (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; clinical drug history and resolution after withdrawal distinguish it from MDS.
Eosinophils are also typically bilobed but contain abundant large orange-red granules rather than pale agranular cytoplasm.

61278.recognize_zh: 軟組織切片被成片的中大型不成熟細胞浸潤於膠原纖維之間，核圓至橢圓、染色質細緻、核仁明顯，細胞質中等量、淡嗜酸性，並有分裂相；下格 PAX5 呈弱至中等核染色。t(8;21) AML 的母細胞常異常表現 PAX5/CD19，不可因此誤判為 B 細胞淋巴瘤或混合表現型白血病。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of discohesive medium to large immature cells dissecting between eosinophilic collagen bundles
Round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale granular amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional apoptotic cells
Bottom panel, PAX5 IHC: weak to moderate nuclear staining in the majority of tumor cells, with negative stromal/endothelial cells
61278.describe_en: Soft tissue biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of discohesive medium to large immature cells percolating between collagen bundles. The cells have round to oval, focally indented nuclei with fine chromatin, distinct nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale granular cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies. PAX5 immunostaining shows weak to moderate nuclear positivity in most tumor cells. Myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117, MPO) and cytogenetics are required, because aberrant PAX5/CD19 expression is characteristic of AML with t(8;21). Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma representing relapse of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are strongly CD20/PAX5 positive and myeloid-marker negative, whereas these PAX5-weak blasts express CD13/CD33/CD117 and MPO.
PAX5/CD19 co-expression in AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 is expected and does not qualify, as defining genetic AML takes precedence.
Blasts are TdT and CD79a positive with smaller size and scant cytoplasm, and lack MPO and myeloid antigens.
Cells may have prominent nucleoli but are cohesive, CD45-negative and keratin- or S100/SOX10-positive.

61150.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD117 染色：中至大型、胞質豐富的細胞呈強烈膜狀加胞質棕色陽性，聚集成片與小簇，周圍小型造血細胞為陰性，顯示大量 CD117 強陽性的肥大細胞浸潤。
features: Confluent sheets and clusters of medium to large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD117 staining
Positive cells are polygonal with abundant cytoplasm and oval, pale nuclei
Sharp demarcation between the positive infiltrate and CD117-negative small hematopoietic cells
Residual megakaryocyte-sized negative cells and fat spaces in the background
Infiltrate occupies most of the lower half of the field
61150.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy stained for CD117 shows a dense infiltrate of medium to large polygonal cells with abundant cytoplasm and strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD117 positivity, forming confluent sheets and smaller aggregates. The residual small hematopoietic cells are negative. The pattern and extent of CD117-bright cells indicate extensive marrow infiltration by mast cells, consistent with mast cell leukemia when correlated with tryptase, CD25 and aspirate mast cell count.

ddx.vs: CD117-positive myeloblasts are smaller with high N:C ratio and are CD34/MPO-positive and tryptase-negative.

ddx.dx: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor or melanoma metastasis
ddx.vs: These CD117-positive tumors are spindled or epithelioid masses that are DOG1 or SOX10/melan-A positive, respectively, and tryptase-negative.
Plasma cells are CD138-positive with light-chain restriction and have plasmacytoid cytology.

61022.recognize_zh: 低背景下的紅血球有許多一端變尖的淚滴細胞（dacrocyte），混有卵圓形與拉長的變形紅血球，尾端方向不一；大量淚滴細胞加上明顯變形是骨髓纖維化的經典血片線索。
features: Numerous teardrop-shaped red cells with short to long tapering tails in varying orientations
Admixed ovalocytes, elongated and irregularly shaped poikilocytes
Mild anisocytosis with a few small, irregular cells
Normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor
No leukocytes or platelets identified in this field
61022.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous dacrocytes bearing tails of variable length pointing in random directions, accompanied by ovalocytes and mild anisocytosis. Red cells are normochromic. No white cells, nucleated red cells or platelets are present in this field. The findings are consistent with a myelophthisic process such as primary myelofibrosis, and correlation with the leukocyte differential for leukoerythroblastosis and a bone marrow biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows microcytic hypochromic red cells with prominent target cells and basophilic stippling rather than predominantly normochromic teardrops.
Elliptocytes are symmetric oval or rod-shaped cells without a single tapered tail.
Artifact produces teardrops with tails uniformly aligned in the direction of smearing.
Occasional teardrops may occur but are accompanied by Howell-Jolly bodies, target cells and acanthocytes.

60894.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下兩個相鄰的紅血球前驅細胞，核內高電子密度的異染色質聚集成粗大網狀帶並散佈許多圓形透亮小孔，呈「瑞士起司」樣外觀，是 CDA type I 的典型超微結構表現。
features: Two adjacent erythroid precursors on transmission electron microscopy
Heterochromatin condensed into thick, irregular, anastomosing electron-dense bands
Multiple round electron-lucent vacuoles within heterochromatin (Swiss cheese appearance)
Intervening pale euchromatin areas; nuclear membrane present
Moderately electron-dense cytoplasm with few organelles
60894.describe_en: Transmission electron microscopy shows two erythroid precursors with abnormal nuclear ultrastructure.
