The heterochromatin is condensed into coarse, branching electron-dense bands containing numerous small electron-lucent vacuoles, imparting a spongy Swiss cheese appearance, separated by paler euchromatin. The cytoplasm is moderately electron dense with sparse organelles. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type I.

ddx.vs: CDA II shows double peripheral membranes from endoplasmic reticulum under the plasma membrane rather than spongy heterochromatin.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts have fine open chromatin with delayed nuclear maturation, not condensed heterochromatin with lucent vacuoles.
Normal erythroblasts show homogeneous peripheral heterochromatin clumps without internal vacuoles.

60830.recognize_zh: 周邊血中散在小至中型、核質比極高、染色質均勻深染或細緻、胞質極少的淋巴樣細胞，外觀像母細胞；在異體幹細胞移植後的情境下，這類細胞多為重建中的 B 細胞（hematogone-like），需流式確認成熟度而非直接判為復發。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells, slightly larger than red cells, with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with homogeneous, smudged-to-fine dark chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm, often barely visible; no granules or Auer rods
Occasional larger cell with more open chromatin and slightly irregular contour (panel A center)
Scattered in a background of normocytic red cells with mild anisocytosis (panel B low power)
60830.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous dark to finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm, imparting a blast-like appearance. An occasional larger cell has more open chromatin. No Auer rods, granules or dysplastic myeloid cells are seen, and the red cells show only mild anisocytosis. Morphology alone cannot distinguish these cells from leukemic blasts; in the post-allogeneic transplant setting, findings are suggestive of regenerating B cells, and flow cytometry demonstrating a maturing, non-aberrant B-cell continuum (CD19+, variable CD10/CD20/CD34/TdT) is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemic lymphoblasts show an aberrant, maturation-arrested immunophenotype on flow cytometry (uniform CD34/TdT, CD58 or CD38 aberrancies, loss of CD45) and often matching the original leukemia-associated phenotype or MRD markers.
Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 rather than B-cell antigens.

ddx.dx: Mature small B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase (e.g., mantle cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Mature B-cell neoplasms show clumped chromatin, light-chain restriction and lack CD34/TdT, whereas regenerating B cells are polyclonal with a physiologic maturation spectrum.

captions: A: montage of individual blast-like lymphoid cells after allogeneic stem cell transplantation
B: low-power field showing scattered small blast-like lymphoid cells

60766.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中性球只有兩個大塊狀、染色質粗凝的核葉，以細絲相連（pince-nez 樣的雙葉核），胞質顆粒大致保留；在晚期 HIV 病人，這種假性 Pelger 核低分葉屬於後天性的發育異常變化。
features: Neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus whose two lobes are connected by a thin chromatin filament (pince-nez configuration)
Lobes are large and somewhat irregular with coarsely clumped chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm with preserved fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and rouleaux-like stacking
60766.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a hyposegmented, bilobed nucleus in which two coarsely clumped lobes are joined by a thin filament, producing a pseudo-Pelger (pince-nez) appearance. The cytoplasm retains fine specific granules without obvious hypogranulation in this cell. Red cells show mild anisocytosis. In a patient with advanced HIV infection, this acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huet change is consistent with HIV-related myelodysplastic change, though a primary myelodysplastic neoplasm and drug effect should be considered clinically.

ddx.vs: Affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation in an asymptomatic person, whereas acquired changes are variable and accompany cytopenias or other dysplasia.
Also shows pseudo-Pelger cells, often with hypogranulation, but requires persistent cytopenias, multilineage dysplasia and/or clonal genetic abnormalities without a reversible cause.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g. mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by medication history and resolution after withdrawal.
Has a curved, non-segmented band of uniform width without two discrete lobes joined by a filament.

60574.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片有片狀壞死與核碎片，高倍下可見核增大、染色質呈毛玻璃狀（ground-glass）且邊緣化、甚至多核相互擠壓（molding）的病毒感染細胞；免疫染色 HSV 在壞死區周圍大量細胞呈強陽性，符合單純皰疹病毒淋巴結炎。
features: Lymph node with extensive necrosis, karyorrhectic debris and effacement of normal architecture
Enlarged cells with smudged, glassy (ground-glass) nuclei, chromatin margination and nuclear molding, including multinucleated forms
Background of fibrinoid necrosis with scattered inflammatory cells; neutrophil-poor
IHC for HSV: strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in numerous cells at the edge of necrosis
60574.describe_en: Lymph node section shows areas of necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris replacing the normal architecture. At high power there are enlarged cells with glassy, smudged nuclei showing chromatin margination, nuclear molding and occasional multinucleation, consistent with herpesviral cytopathic effect. Immunohistochemistry for herpes simplex virus is strongly positive in numerous cells in and around the necrotic areas. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis; this may coexist with an underlying lymphoma such as CLL/SLL and should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi shows crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells around apoptotic debris without viral inclusions and is HSV negative.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin or anaplastic large cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Large atypical cells have prominent macronucleoli and are CD30 positive, rather than ground-glass nuclei with molding that stain for HSV.
CMV cells show large eosinophilic 'owl-eye' intranuclear inclusions with halos plus cytoplasmic granules and are CMV IHC positive.
Lupus lymphadenitis shows hematoxylin bodies and vasculitis without viral cytopathic changes.

60638.recognize_zh: A 圖為 CML 典型的顆粒球各階段成熟細胞與嗜鹼性球；B 圖則出現大量細胞質深藍、含少量粗大嗜鹼性顆粒的芽細胞與異常嗜鹼性球（右下插圖），符合 CML 嗜鹼性芽細胞期。
features: Panel A: granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils) with basophils, typical of chronic phase CML
Panel B: many medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Several blasts and immature cells contain coarse dark basophilic granules, some obscuring the nucleus, indicating basophilic differentiation
Inset: large blast with fine chromatin and a rim of cytoplasm containing few basophilic granules
Background platelet clumps/fragments and red cells without significant poikilocytosis
60638.describe_en: Composite figure. Panel A shows a left-shifted granulocytic proliferation with all stages of maturation and scattered basophils, as seen in chronic phase chronic myeloid leukemia. Panel B shows replacement by numerous blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, many of which contain coarse dark metachromatic granules, together with hypogranular immature basophils; the inset highlights a blast with sparse basophilic granules. Confirmation by toluidine blue metachromasia, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD25) and BCR::ABL1 testing is advised. Findings are consistent with basophilic blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical, but de novo disease lacks a preceding chronic phase and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Accelerated phase has increased mature basophils (≥20%) but blasts remain below the blast-phase threshold, unlike the blast-rich field in panel B.
Mast cells have oval nuclei and more evenly distributed granules and express CD117/tryptase strongly with KIT D816V, whereas basophilic blasts are CD123+ and CD117 negative.

ddx.dx: CML myeloid blast phase without basophilic differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts show azurophilic granules or Auer rods rather than coarse metachromatic basophilic granules.

60702.recognize_zh: 周邊血中增加的「淋巴球」其實核偏一側、染色質粗塊狀、旁邊有一圈窄的藍色細胞質（B 箭頭）；高倍 C 還看到雙核與多核的漿細胞，因此是被血球計數器誤判為淋巴球增多的非典型漿細胞白血病。
features: Panel A: increased small mononuclear cells resembling mature lymphocytes, with occasional neutrophils
Small cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and a narrow rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B (arrows): cells with eccentric nuclei and a crescent of basophilic cytoplasm, suggesting plasmacytoid differentiation
Panel C: binucleated plasma cells and a large multinucleated plasma cell with abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Red cells show mild rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas
60702.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small mononuclear cells that at low power resemble mature lymphocytes. At higher magnification, many have eccentrically placed nuclei with clumped chromatin and a narrow crescent of basophilic cytoplasm, and binucleated and multinucleated plasma cells are also present. Findings are consistent with circulating atypical (lymphoplasmacytoid) plasma cells, supporting plasma cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD38 bright, CD138+, cytoplasmic light chain restriction) is recommended because automated counters may report these cells as lymphocytes.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have central round nuclei with block-like chromatin, smudge cells and CD5/CD23/CD19 expression, without binucleated plasma cells.
LPL shows a spectrum of CD20+ lymphocytes to plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 mutation rather than a CD138+/CD19− clonal plasma cell population.
Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, polytypic and accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, not numerous atypical multinucleated forms.

60510.recognize_zh: 細胞略大於紅血球，圓核染色質濃縮成塊、無核仁，周圍有一圈稍寬的淡藍色細胞質且無顆粒，是正常的靜止淋巴球。
features: Small round cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a slightly wider rim of pale blue cytoplasm than the smallest lymphocytes
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin
No visible nucleolus
Cytoplasm is agranular with a slightly irregular outer border; normal background red cells
60510.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small round lymphocyte slightly larger than adjacent red cells, with a round nucleus composed of coarse clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus. There is a narrow rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal resting lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are larger with more abundant cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia that molds around red cells, and often more open chromatin.
Individual CLL cells look similar, so distinction relies on an absolute monoclonal CD5+/CD23+ B-lymphocytosis rather than single-cell morphology.
LGLs are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules.

60446.recognize_zh: 中央這顆巨核細胞體積大、細胞質豐富偏嗜鹼性，但核不是一團多葉相連的核，而是分成三個大小不一、彼此完全分開的圓形核（separated nuclear lobes），屬於 MDS 型巨核細胞發育不良；配合 GATA2 生殖細胞突變與第 7 號染色體單體，支持 GATA2 缺乏相關的兒童難治性血球減少症。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant, finely granular, pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm
Three widely separated, round, non-lobated nuclei of unequal size (multiple separated nuclei)
Nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin; the largest shows a pale nucleolus-like clearing
Adjacent small mononuclear cells including a mitotic figure (left) and lymphocyte-sized cells
Scattered red cells and platelet-like debris in background; no blasts in this field
60446.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm containing three discrete, round, widely separated nuclei of varying size rather than a single multilobated nucleus. Surrounding cells include small mononuclear hematopoietic cells, one in mitosis, and no increased blasts are seen in this field. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a recognized dysplastic form. In a patient with germline GATA2 mutation and monosomy 7, this finding supports myelodysplasia, consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood related to GATA2 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have a single polyploid nucleus with lobes connected by chromatin, whereas this cell has completely separate round nuclei.

Osteoclasts contain many (often >5) uniform, small, evenly spaced nuclei with single nucleoli and granular pink-purple cytoplasm, while dysplastic megakaryocytes have few unequal nuclei and platelet-type cytoplasm; CD61/CD42b staining confirms megakaryocytic lineage.
Occasional separated nuclei can occur reactively, so dysplasia must involve >=10% of megakaryocytes and be supported by cytogenetics such as monosomy 7.

60382.recognize_zh: CD5 免疫染色中幾乎所有小淋巴球都呈強烈而完整的細胞膜陽性，形成密集一片的棕色網格，只有中央少數組織球／血管區為陰性；在 SLL 中，腫瘤性 B 細胞與背景 T 細胞都表現 CD5，因此整片陽性，需對照 CD3 才能區分兩者。
features: CD5 IHC with diffuse, strong membranous staining of nearly all small lymphoid cells
Monotonous small round cells densely packed in a sheet-like pattern
Small unstained areas corresponding to vessels, histiocytes or stromal cells (e.g., center right)
No large cell sheets identifiable in this field
Staining includes both neoplastic B cells and background T cells (not separable on this stain alone)
60382.describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse, strong membranous staining of a dense, monotonous population of small lymphoid cells, with only small unstained areas corresponding to vessels and histiocytes. Because both the neoplastic CLL/SLL B cells and reactive T cells express CD5, nearly the entire infiltrate is positive. Comparison with CD3, which stains fewer cells, and with CD20/CD23 confirms aberrant CD5 expression by the B-cell population. The findings are consistent with involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma, the background for the Hodgkin-type Richter transformation in this case.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma, but cells are slightly irregular and express cyclin D1 and SOX11 while lacking CD23 and LEF1.
A pure T-cell process would show CD3 staining equivalent to CD5 and negative CD20/PAX5, whereas here CD3 stains fewer cells than CD5.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles with CD5-negative germinal center B cells, rather than effacing sheets of CD5-positive small cells.

60190.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中央有兩顆芽細胞：中等大小、核質比高、染色質細緻、可見淡色核仁、胞質少且呈藍色無顆粒；右上與下方的顆粒球核型不成熟卻胞質幾乎無顆粒（hypogranular），顯示合併顆粒球發育不良，符合伴隨過多芽細胞的MDS。
features: Two blasts: medium-sized, round nuclei, high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm is scant, pale blue and agranular without Auer rods
Hypogranular myeloid precursors (metamyelocyte/band forms) with pale gray cytoplasm and indented nuclei
Scattered normochromic red cells and platelets in a thinly spread area
60190.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two blasts of medium size with round nuclei, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods are seen. Adjacent maturing granulocytes, including metamyelocyte and band forms, are hypogranular with pale cytoplasm. Blasts must be quantified on a 500-cell differential; with 12% blasts and dysgranulopoiesis, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts (former RAEB-2).

ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts in the marrow differential (or a defining genetic abnormality), whereas MDS-EB has 10–19% blasts in the RAEB-2 range.
Hematogones have homogeneous smudged chromatin, very scant cytoplasm and no nucleoli, with a maturing B-cell pattern on flow cytometry.
Mature lymphocytes have condensed chromatin without nucleoli; lymphoma cells are identified by lymphoid immunophenotype rather than CD34/CD117 myeloid blast markers.
Recovering marrow shows promyelocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and a Golgi zone and normally granulated maturing neutrophils, not agranular blasts with hypogranular progeny.

60126.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央的嗜中性球只有兩個上下排列的核葉、染色質緻密粗塊，細胞質顆粒正常，呈 Pelger-Huët 異常的雙葉（啞鈴/眼鏡狀）核型。
features: Neutrophil with two nuclear lobes (bilobed) in a pince-nez/dumbbell configuration
Dense, coarsely clumped mature chromatin in each lobe
Lobes connected by a thin chromatin strand (only faintly visible at this resolution)
Cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granulation
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
60126.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus in a pince-nez configuration, composed of two dense lobes with coarsely clumped chromatin joined by a thin strand. The cytoplasm is normally granulated. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. In an otherwise healthy individual with most neutrophils affected, findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly.

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are often hypogranular, involve a subset of neutrophils and accompany cytopenias or dysplasia, unlike the inherited anomaly.
A band has a continuous curved nucleus of uniform width without pinched lobes and has less condensed chromatin.
Eosinophils are typically bilobed but contain large refractile orange granules, whereas this cell has fine neutrophilic granules.

60062.recognize_zh: 這是周邊血液流式細胞圖：紅色族群位於 CD45 弱陽性/陰性、低側散射（SSC）的「母細胞區」，約占 44%，並呈 CD19+、CD10 強陽性、CD34+、HLA-DR+，而 CD20、CD13、CD117 陰性；這組免疫表型即為 B 淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）。
features: CD45 vs SSC: red population (about 44%) in the dim-to-negative CD45, low SSC blast gate, distinct from granulocytes (green), monocytes (cyan), and lymphocytes (blue)
CD19 vs CD45: blasts are CD19 positive with dim CD45, separate from normal CD45-bright B cells
CD10 vs CD34 and HLA-DR vs CD34: blasts are uniformly CD10 bright, CD34 positive, and HLA-DR positive
CD10 vs CD20: blasts are CD20 negative, unlike mature CD20-positive B cells
CD13 vs CD117: blasts negative for CD117 and essentially negative for CD13, whereas granulocytes express CD13
60062.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood shows an abnormal population (red) comprising approximately 43-44% of events, located in the dim-to-negative CD45, low side-scatter region. The population is positive for CD19, CD34, HLA-DR, and bright CD10 (with CD22 and CD58 reported), and negative for CD20, CD117, CD13, CD33, and surface immunoglobulin light chains. Normal granulocytes, monocytes, and CD45-bright lymphocytes, including mature CD20-positive B cells, serve as internal controls. This immunophenotype is consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia; cytogenetic and molecular studies are needed for risk classification.

ddx.vs: Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum from CD34+/CD10 bright to CD20+/CD10 dim with normal CD45 and CD58, rather than a discrete CD45-dim, uniform CD34+/CD10 bright/CD20-negative cluster.
AML blasts in the same CD45-dim gate would express myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33, CD117, or MPO, which are negative here.
Requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation in addition to strong B markers; absence of CD13/CD33/CD117 argues against it.
Burkitt cells are CD10+ and CD19+ but CD34 and TdT negative, CD20 and surface light chain positive, with bright CD45.

17950.recognize_zh: 這是存活曲線圖而非形態圖：上圖 DNMT3A 或 NPM1 突變、或 MLL 易位者，高劑量 daunorubicin 的整體存活明顯優於標準劑量（P=0.001）；下圖野生型者兩組無差異（P=0.67），下方表格列出3年存活率。
features: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves, not a morphologic image
Top panel: mutant DNMT3A or NPM1, or MLL translocation; high-dose curve above standard-dose (P=0.001)
Bottom panel: wild-type DNMT3A and NPM1 without MLL translocation; overlapping curves (P=0.67)
Numbers at risk listed below each plot
Summary table: 3-year OS 44% vs 25% in the mutant group; 35% vs 39% in all other genotypes
17950.describe_en: This figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) presents Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves comparing high-dose versus standard-dose daunorubicin induction in AML according to genotype. Patients with DNMT3A or NPM1 mutations or MLL (KMT2A) translocations had significantly improved survival with high-dose therapy (3-year OS 44% versus 25%, P=0.001), whereas patients lacking these lesions derived no apparent benefit (35% versus 39%, P=0.67). The figure illustrates the use of molecular profiling to predict response to dose-intensified induction. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

16926.recognize_zh: 骨小樑邊緣呈不規則扇貝狀（scalloped），小樑之間的骨髓腔被鬆散的纖維組織與梭形細胞取代，幾乎看不到造血細胞，符合腎性骨病變的纖維性骨炎（osteitis fibrosa）。
features: Thick, irregular bone trabeculae with scalloped, eroded margins suggesting increased resorption
Intertrabecular marrow space replaced by loose fibrous stroma with scattered spindle-shaped fibroblast-like cells
Paratrabecular accentuation of cellular fibrous tissue along bone surfaces
Scattered small osteocyte lacunae within eosinophilic lamellar/woven bone
Near-absence of recognizable hematopoietic elements and fat cells in this field
16926.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, faded older preparation) shows thickened, irregular bone trabeculae with scalloped resorptive margins. The intertrabecular spaces are occupied by loose fibrous tissue containing scattered spindle cells, with paratrabecular accentuation, and normal hematopoietic tissue and fat are essentially absent in this field. Discrete osteoclasts and osteoid seams cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification and staining quality. In the setting of untreated chronic renal failure, findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa (renal osteodystrophy due to secondary hyperparathyroidism) with marrow fibrosis contributing to anemia.

ddx.vs: PMF shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis, whereas renal osteodystrophy shows peritrabecular fibrosis with scalloped resorption and osteoclast activity without megakaryocytic atypia.
The marrow and bone changes are morphologically identical; distinction depends on renal function and serum calcium/phosphate/PTH profile.
Metastases show cohesive epithelial clusters within the fibrosis (keratin positive), which are not seen in this image.
Paget disease shows a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines and large multinucleated osteoclasts rather than predominantly peritrabecular fibrosis.

15326.recognize_zh: 周邊血液有一個中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍且四周佈滿細毛狀突起（箭頭）；骨髓切片中則同時可見 PV 的大型分葉異常巨核細胞（實線箭頭）與間質中卵圓核的淋巴樣細胞浸潤（虛線箭頭），提示 PV 背景上發生毛狀細胞白血病變異型。
features: Panel A (PB): medium-to-large lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and circumferential fine hairy projections (arrow)
Hairy cell nucleus round-oval with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleolus not clearly resolved at this magnification
Nearby small lymphocyte and scattered platelets; red cells with occasional target and stomatocytic forms
Panel B (BM biopsy H&E): hypercellular marrow with large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes (solid arrows) consistent with MPN
Interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and clear-to-pale cytoplasm (dashed arrows)
15326.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-to-large lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue cytoplasm bearing circumferential hairy projections (arrow) and a round-oval nucleus. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and contains large, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes (solid arrows) consistent with the known JAK2 V617F-positive polycythemia vera, admixed with an interstitial infiltrate of lymphoid cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm (dashed arrows). Morphology alone cannot distinguish classic hairy cell leukemia from its variant; flow cytometry (CD25/CD123/annexin A1 negativity in the variant), BRAF V600E testing and MAP2K1 analysis are required. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli) arising in a patient with polycythemia vera.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has no prominent nucleolus, presents with monocytopenia, and is CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E mutated, whereas the variant is CD25−, annexin A1−, BRAF wild type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi, less abundant cytoplasm and a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villi and a predominantly intrasinusoidal marrow pattern; distinction from HCL-v relies on nucleolar prominence and immunophenotype and may be difficult.
Myelofibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes with reticulin fibrosis and leukoerythroblastosis but no clonal B-cell infiltrate with hairy projections.

15198.recognize_zh: 這是頭部矢狀面顯影電腦斷層（CT venography），箭頭指向上矢狀竇（superior sagittal sinus）處顯影缺損，提示靜脈竇血栓；在急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）的情境下，要想到凝血異常或 ATRA 相關的血栓併發症。
features: Sagittal contrast-enhanced CT (CT venogram) of the head
Arrow indicates the superior sagittal sinus near the vertex
Apparent filling defect/reduced opacification of the sinus at the arrow, suggesting cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
Cortical veins and deep venous structures otherwise opacified
No morphologic (cellular) findings; radiologic image only
15198.describe_en: Sagittal contrast-enhanced CT venogram of the head. The arrow points to the superior sagittal sinus, where there appears to be a filling defect with reduced contrast opacification, consistent with cerebral venous sinus thrombosis; resolution of the reproduced image limits detailed assessment. No intraparenchymal hemorrhage is evident on this single slice. In a patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia, this finding illustrates that thrombosis, not only hemorrhage, can complicate APL-associated coagulopathy and its treatment (e.g., ATRA).

ddx.vs: Hemorrhage appears as hyperdense parenchymal, subdural or subarachnoid blood on non-contrast CT, rather than a non-opacified venous sinus on venography.
Arachnoid granulations are small, round, well-defined defects often with CSF density, whereas thrombosis produces a longer segmental filling defect confirmed on MR venography.

ddx.dx: Dural sinus invasion by myeloid sarcoma or meningeal leukemia
ddx.vs: Tumor shows enhancing soft-tissue mass or dural thickening rather than a purely intraluminal non-enhancing clot.

13022.recognize_zh: 這是未染色腦脊髓液在血球計數盤格線上的濕片，中央的「細胞」是一顆邊界清楚、內含細小顆粒與小折光點的圓形顆粒，沒有真正的核構造，實為鞘內注射的脂質體阿糖胞苷（DepoCyte）顆粒，造成假性白血球增多。
features: Unstained wet preparation in a hemocytometer counting chamber with visible grid lines
Large round particle with a crisp refractile outer membrane and fine internal granular/vesicular texture
Tiny refractile dots within the particle but no discernible nucleus
Few smaller round refractile bodies in the background
No red cells or clearly nucleated leukocytes identified
13022.describe_en: Unstained cerebrospinal fluid examined in a hemocytometer chamber shows a large round particle with a sharp refractile outline and a finely granular internal texture containing tiny refractile dots, without a definable nucleus. A few smaller round refractile bodies are present in the background. Nucleated cell identification cannot be made reliably on an unstained chamber count. In a patient receiving intrathecal liposomal cytarabine, these structures are consistent with DepoCyte lipid particles, which can be miscounted as white cells (spurious pleocytosis); a stained cytospin should be reviewed before attributing an elevated count to disease progression.

ddx.vs: Malignant lymphoid cells are nucleated and persist on stained cytospin, whereas DepoCyte particles are anuclear and do not survive cytospin preparation.
Cryptococci are smaller budding yeasts with a clear capsule highlighted by India ink, not large finely vesicular spheres.

ddx.dx: Starch granules or glove powder contaminant
ddx.vs: Starch granules show a central Maltese-cross birefringence under polarized light.
Macrophages have a visible eccentric nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm on stained preparations.

12510.recognize_zh: A 圖抹片可見大量聚集的母細胞（染色質細緻、核有摺痕、偶見核內空泡），代表高白血球血症；B 圖 CT 與 C 圖 MRI 箭頭處顯示多處腦實質出血／病灶，合併起來指向白血病性白血球淤滯（leukostasis）造成的中樞神經併發症。
features: Panel A: numerous blasts in a crowded aggregate, with high N:C ratio and fine dispersed chromatin
Blasts have round to folded or indented nuclei, some with small nucleoli and a nuclear pseudo-inclusion/cup-like clear area
Scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm; occasional segmented neutrophil
Panel B: non-contrast head CT with multiple small hyperdense foci (arrows), suggesting hemorrhage
Panel C: axial FLAIR MRI with multiple rim-like lesions in bilateral hemispheres (arrows)
12510.describe_en: Smear (panel A) shows a marked increase in blasts clustered together, with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, round to folded nuclei with occasional clear nuclear invaginations and scant agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not identified at this magnification. Head CT (panel B) demonstrates multiple small hyperdense parenchymal foci, and FLAIR MRI (panel C) shows multifocal lesions with surrounding signal change in both hemispheres. Findings are consistent with hyperleukocytic acute leukemia complicated by CNS leukostasis with multifocal intracerebral hemorrhage; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry and cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: CNS infiltration by leukemia (myeloid sarcoma / leptomeningeal disease)
ddx.vs: Parenchymal or meningeal leukemic masses enhance and show blasts in CSF, whereas leukostasis produces microvascular occlusion with hemorrhagic foci in the setting of very high blast counts.

ddx.dx: Hemorrhage due to DIC in acute promyelocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: APL shows hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rod bundles and coagulopathy, while the blasts here are agranular; PML-RARA testing resolves it.
Infectious lesions are ring-enhancing abscesses with fever and positive cultures rather than hemorrhagic foci accompanying a blast-dominated smear.

1310.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見許多母細胞成群聚集成小團塊（clumps），散在紅血球之間，另有不少破碎的淡紫色塗抹細胞；巨核母細胞容易彼此黏聚成團，這是 ML-DS／急性巨核母細胞白血病在塗片上常見的低倍線索。
features: Low-power smear with numerous small cohesive clusters of blasts scattered among red cells
Blasts are small to medium with dark round nuclei and scant cytoplasm; fine detail not resolvable at this magnification
Frequent pale, smudged/disrupted nucleated cells
Sparse mature granulocytes between clusters
Cytoplasmic blebs and platelet budding cannot be assessed at this power
1310.describe_en: Low-power view of a smear, most consistent with peripheral blood or a hemodiluted aspirate, shows numerous nucleated cells that aggregate into small cohesive clusters distributed among red cells, with frequent smudged cells in the background. At this magnification the clustered cells appear to be blasts with dark round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, but cytoplasmic blebs, granules and nucleoli cannot be evaluated. Clumping of blasts is a recognized feature of megakaryoblasts; in a patient with Down syndrome, the findings are suggestive of myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome, pending high-power review and flow cytometry for CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cell clusters in children can mimic clumped megakaryoblasts, and the distinction requires CD41/CD61 expression versus CD45-negative, neural marker-positive tumor cells.
Morphologically identical, separated by neonatal onset and spontaneous regression in TAM.
Lymphoblasts usually lie as dispersed single cells rather than cohesive clumps and lack megakaryocytic markers.

1118.recognize_zh: 高倍下一團中型母細胞，胞質深藍色、邊緣排列許多清楚圓形空泡，染色質細緻，是 Burkitt 細胞的教科書外觀；中間夾一顆粉紅顆粒的骨髓細胞可作大小對照。
features: Cluster of medium-sized, monomorphic blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei
Finely stippled chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple sharply defined, round clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, some overlying the nucleus
Interspersed granulocytic precursor (myelocyte) with pink granular cytoplasm for comparison
1118.describe_en: High-power view of a smear shows a cluster of monomorphic medium-sized blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount, deeply basophilic, and contains numerous sharply demarcated round vacuoles, some superimposed over the nucleus. A maturing myelocyte with pink granular cytoplasm is present within the cluster. Findings are consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires mature B-cell immunophenotype with CD10 expression, absent BCL2 and TdT, and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without prominent vacuoles and are TdT/CD34 positive without surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: These may mimic Burkitt morphology but express BCL2 and show BCL2 rearrangement by FISH.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts (e.g., erythroid or monocytic)
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO/NSE or erythroid marker positive and lack a B-cell phenotype.

1054.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中白血球數增加且種類混雜：分葉嗜中性球、未成熟顆粒球、深染的嗜鹼性球，以及數顆較大、胞質嗜鹼性的母細胞樣細胞，提示 CML 疾病進展；細節需高倍確認。
features: Increased leukocytes at low power with a mixed granulocytic population
Segmented neutrophils and immature granulocytes with granular cytoplasm
Small cells with dense dark granules consistent with basophils
Several larger cells with high N:C ratio and basophilic cytoplasm, suspicious for blasts
Red cells with target-like and stomatocyte-like central clearing, likely partly drying artifact; platelets present
1054.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows increased leukocytes composed of segmented neutrophils, immature granulocytes, basophils, and several larger cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and basophilic cytoplasm that are suspicious for blasts. Red cells show variable central clearing, partly attributable to drying artifact, and platelets are present. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. In a patient with CML, findings are suggestive of disease progression with basophilia and circulating blasts; a manual differential and ABL1 kinase domain mutation testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase shows a leukocytosis dominated by myelocytes and neutrophils with few blasts, whereas accelerated/blast phase shows increasing blasts and basophils.
Leukemoid reactions show toxic changes without basophilia or blasts and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
CMML features absolute monocytosis and dysplasia without basophilia or BCR::ABL1.

4190.recognize_zh: 中央右側淋巴球的細胞核深度分葉，呈花瓣或苜蓿葉狀（flower cell），染色質凝集、無明顯核仁；旁邊與左上另有核形不規則的異型淋巴球，為成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）的典型周邊血表現。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a deeply multilobated, clover-leaf ('flower cell') nucleus
Condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli; scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Adjacent smaller lymphocyte with irregular, indented nucleus and small cytoplasmic projections
Larger atypical lymphoid cell at upper left with irregular nuclear contour and moderate pale cytoplasm
Background normocytic RBCs with mild poikilocytosis
4190.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphoid cells, including a medium-sized cell with a deeply multilobated, petal-like 'flower' nucleus, condensed chromatin, no visible nucleolus and scant basophilic cytoplasm. An adjacent smaller lymphocyte and a larger cell at the upper left also show irregular nuclear contours. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. The flower-cell morphology is characteristic of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than discrete petal-like lobes and lack HTLV-1.
T-PLL cells have round or mildly irregular nuclei with a visible nucleolus and blebbed basophilic cytoplasm.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and lobes connected by thin filaments rather than clustered lobes in agranular cytoplasm.
Reactive cells show only mild indentation, abundant cytoplasm and a polyclonal heterogeneous population.

3998.recognize_zh: 脂肪間的巨噬細胞胞質內塞滿大量約 2–4 µm 的小圓點狀微生物，這就是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）；在 HIV 病人骨髓中要優先想到內臟利什曼病。
features: Enlarged macrophages with abundant pale foamy cytoplasm
Numerous tiny (2–4 um) round-to-oval dot-like intracytoplasmic organisms (amastigotes)
Organisms individually discernible, not a single large inclusion
Scattered adjacent hematopoietic cells and plasma-cell-like cells
Background fatty marrow with thin stromal septa; small refractile crystalline material near the macrophage
3998.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows fatty marrow with scattered hematopoietic elements. A cluster of enlarged histiocytes contains numerous small, round-to-oval intracytoplasmic organisms measuring approximately 2–4 um, consistent with amastigotes. Individual kinetoplasts cannot be reliably resolved at this magnification and stain. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (Leishman-Donovan bodies) in the marrow of an immunocompromised host; correlation with a Giemsa-stained aspirate, culture, or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and stain with GMS/PAS and lack the rod-shaped kinetoplast seen in Leishmania amastigotes.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by central septation (transverse wall) and are GMS-positive, whereas Leishmania has a nucleus plus kinetoplast and is GMS-negative.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped and lack a kinetoplast, and are confirmed by Toxoplasma IHC.
Overlying platelets or debris are irregular in size and not uniformly packed within the cytoplasm as discrete organisms.

3870.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中在淡粉紅色的纖維素樣背景裡，組織球的細胞質內（箭頭）塞滿許多帶透明暈的小圓點狀微生物，形成鬆散的肉芽腫性組織球浸潤，符合組織漿菌感染。
features: Loose aggregate of histiocytes within a pale eosinophilic, fibrinous background
Histiocytes with foamy cytoplasm containing numerous tiny round organisms with clear halos (arrow)
Organisms uniform, approximately 2–4 µm
Absence of well-formed epithelioid granuloma or giant cells
Scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and erythroid precursors at the periphery
Surrounding adipocytes
3870.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a poorly formed histiocytic infiltrate within a pale eosinophilic fibrinous background. Several histiocytes contain numerous small, uniform, round intracytoplasmic organisms with surrounding clear halos (arrow), measuring approximately 2–4 µm. Well-formed epithelioid granulomas and giant cells are not seen, and scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and erythroid precursors are present at the periphery. Findings are consistent with a loose granulomatous response to intracellular yeasts, suggestive of disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are similar in size but show a kinetoplast, are GMS negative and may be CD1a positive, whereas Histoplasma is GMS and PAS positive.
MAC produces foamy histiocytes with striated cytoplasm filled with acid-fast bacilli rather than discrete haloed yeasts.
Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and more variable with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Gelatinous transformation shows amorphous pale extracellular material without histiocytes laden with organisms.

3934.recognize_zh: 標題是 cytogram，但圖其實是低倍周邊血抹片：紅血球之間密密麻麻都是大小相近、核質比高的單一形態芽細胞，白血球數量明顯超量，符合 AML 高白血球症的血液外觀。
features: Markedly increased leukocytes at low power, nearly one nucleated cell per few red cells
Monotonous population of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli and granules not resolvable at this magnification
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm; rare mature lymphocyte for comparison
Red cells without significant poikilocytosis
3934.describe_en: Although titled as a cytogram, this image is a low-power peripheral blood smear rather than an automated analyzer plot. It shows striking leukocytosis composed of a monotonous population of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and scant pale-blue cytoplasm; nucleoli, granules and Auer rods cannot be assessed at this magnification. Mature leukocytes are rare. Findings are consistent with hyperleukocytosis due to acute leukemia, in keeping with the stated AML; the high blast count predisposes to leukostasis and can interfere with automated counts.

ddx.vs: Morphology at low power cannot separate them; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry for myeloid versus lymphoid markers are required.
CLL cells are small mature lymphocytes with clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin and smudge cells rather than large blasts with fine chromatin.
CML shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks, basophilia, and few blasts in chronic phase.

3742.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質淡灰藍、邊界模糊，內含一顆被吞噬的完整嗜中性球（帶狀核）以及許多深色碎屑顆粒，核圓形偏一側，屬吞噬性巨噬細胞（噬血現象）。
features: Very large macrophage with abundant, pale grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Engulfed intact neutrophil (band form) within the cytoplasm
Numerous dark phagocytosed nuclear debris and pigment-like granules
Round nucleus with fine reticular chromatin and a small nucleolus; low N:C ratio
Surrounding erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and red cells in a marrow aspirate background
3742.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm containing an intact engulfed band neutrophil together with multiple dark phagocytosed nuclear fragments and granular debris. The macrophage nucleus is round with fine chromatin. Adjacent erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are unremarkable. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis by an activated macrophage; this can be seen in reactive states and should be correlated with clinical and laboratory criteria before a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is made.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris but not intact hematopoietic cells such as a neutrophil.
Superimposed cells lie on a different focal plane and lack a clear cytoplasmic vacuole surrounding the engulfed cell.
In emperipolesis the engulfed cells are viable, mostly lymphocytes within S100+ histiocytes or megakaryocytes, rather than degraded cells with debris.

3614.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆三葉核嗜中性球，細胞質左下方（箭頭）有一小團深紫色、細點狀聚集的包涵體，即桑椹體（morula）；位於嗜中性球內，符合顆粒球無形體症（Anaplasma phagocytophilum）感染。
features: Trilobed segmented neutrophil with a stippled, deep purple intracytoplasmic morula (arrow)
Morula is compact, granular, and separate from the nuclear lobes
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink granules and an elongated pseudopod
Background echinocytes (crenated red cells) and a rare platelet
3614.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a segmented neutrophil with a compact, stippled, deep purple intracytoplasmic inclusion (arrow) distinct from the nuclear lobes, consistent with a morula. The remaining cytoplasm shows fine pink granules without toxic vacuolization. Background red cells show crenation artifact, and platelets appear sparse. Findings are consistent with neutrophilic morulae of Anaplasma phagocytophilum (human granulocytic anaplasmosis); peripheral smear sensitivity is limited and PCR is the preferred confirmatory test.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue-gray, amorphous, and peripheral rather than dark purple and finely stippled.
A superimposed platelet lies in a different focal plane with a pale hyalomere and is not bounded within the cytoplasm.
Histoplasma yeasts are oval with a clear halo, and bacteria appear as discrete cocci or rods rather than a mulberry cluster.
Morulae of human monocytic ehrlichiosis are found mainly in monocytes, so species assignment relies on the host cell and PCR.

3678.recognize_zh: 畫面中央一顆大型細胞，有豐富淡灰藍、邊界不規則且含細小顆粒與空泡的細胞質，細胞核圓形、染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，是骨髓中的網狀細胞（reticulum cell，即巨噬／基質組織球）。
features: Large cell (several times the size of adjacent red cells) with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders with fine granules and small vacuoles
Round to oval nucleus with fine, open reticular chromatin and a visible nucleolus
Low N:C ratio despite the large nucleus
Background normal marrow elements: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
3678.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cell with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders, fine granules and small vacuoles, and a round nucleus with delicate open chromatin and a small nucleolus. The surrounding cells include maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes without atypia. The large cell represents a reticulum cell (marrow macrophage/stromal histiocyte), a normal constituent of the marrow that should not be counted as a blast.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio with a scant to moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm, whereas this cell has abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm with a low N:C ratio.
Osteoblasts have an eccentric nucleus with a distinct paranuclear clear zone (Golgi) away from the nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, usually in clusters.
Tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and cohesive clustering, not a single bland cell with open chromatin among normal marrow cells.

3294.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞約為旁邊小淋巴球的三到四倍大，核圓略偏心、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍色帶細小空泡且邊緣不規則起伏，符合血中反應性組織球（reactive histiocyte）。
features: Large cell, about 3-4 times the diameter of adjacent small lymphocytes
Low N:C ratio with an oval, slightly eccentric nucleus
Finely reticular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and a darker blue peripheral rim
Irregular cytoplasmic border with small blebs; no phagocytosed organisms or cells
Background crenated red cell aggregates and small lymphocytes
3294.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell, three to four times the size of neighboring small lymphocytes, with a low N:C ratio, an oval slightly eccentric nucleus with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm is finely vacuolated with an irregular, blebbed border. No ingested organisms or hematopoietic cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a circulating reactive histiocyte (macrophage); a search for intracellular organisms and phagocytosed cells is recommended in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: Monocytes are smaller with folded, indented nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules.
Hairy cells are smaller (about twice a lymphocyte) with circumferential fine hair-like projections and are CD103/CD11c/CD25-positive.
Plasma cells have coarse clock-face chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a distinct perinuclear hof.
Hemophagocytic macrophages contain ingested red cells, platelets or nucleated cells, which are absent here.

3230.recognize_zh: 中央漿細胞具偏心圓核與核周淡染區，細胞質外圍染成鮮豔洋紅色且邊緣呈毛邊火焰狀，為典型 flame cell；左上角另一顆漿細胞為一般藍色細胞質可作對照。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and coarse, clumped chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with pale-blue perinuclear (Golgi) zone
Intensely magenta-red peripheral cytoplasm with frayed, flame-like border
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles near the cell margin
Neighboring conventional plasma cell with blue cytoplasm; crenated red cells in background
3230.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, a pale perinuclear hof and abundant cytoplasm whose periphery stains intensely magenta with a ragged, flame-like edge. A conventional plasma cell with blue cytoplasm is present at the upper left for comparison. The background red cells are crenated. Findings represent a flame cell, reflecting accumulation of glycoprotein-rich immunoglobulin, classically associated with IgA multiple myeloma though also seen in other plasma cell disorders.

ddx.vs: Mott cells are packed with discrete round pale globules (Russell bodies) instead of a diffuse magenta cytoplasmic fringe.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear PAS+ pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, whereas flame cell change is purely cytoplasmic.
Megakaryocytic cytoplasm is granular pink with platelet budding and lacks a single eccentric clock-face nucleus with perinuclear hof.
Crystal-storing plasma cells show needle- or rhomboid-shaped crystalline inclusions that distort the cytoplasm rather than peripheral magenta staining.

3166.recognize_zh: 低倍下Ommaya引流液抹片中一條細長、扭曲並有分支的線狀組織，由沿長軸排列的梭形核構成，兩端有小團聚集，背景為稀疏紅血球，這是微血管碎片。
features: Long, thin, tortuous and branching strand of tissue at low power
Elongated spindle-shaped nuclei aligned along the strand
Small tangled knot of the strand at the bottom and a looped segment at the top
Paucicellular background with scattered red cells and small amorphous debris
No discrete clusters of atypical cells identified at this magnification
3166.describe_en: Low-power view of a cytospin from an Ommaya reservoir tap shows a long, thin, branching and looping tissue strand containing elongated nuclei aligned along its length. The background is paucicellular with scattered red cells and small debris. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, but the architecture is consistent with a capillary fragment, an incidental finding that should not be interpreted as malignant cells.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are rounded three-dimensional groups with pleomorphic nuclei rather than long thin branching strands with aligned spindle nuclei.
Hyphae are acellular, uniformly wide tubes without nuclei and with septation or acute-angle branching.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strands or cotton fiber contaminant
ddx.vs: Fibrin and fibers lack nuclei, whereas this strand contains aligned endothelial nuclei.

2974.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨噬細胞的核被約九顆吞入的有核細胞（小而深染的圓核，多為紅血球母細胞或淋巴球）團團圍住，細胞質淡藍，是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）的經典影像。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and a central round nucleus with open chromatin
About nine engulfed intact nucleated cells with round dense nuclei surrounding the macrophage nucleus
Engulfed cells sit within clear phagocytic vacuoles
Adjacent cells include a mitotic figure, lymphocytes and myeloid precursors
Background of intact red cells
2974.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm containing approximately nine phagocytosed intact nucleated cells, likely erythroid precursors and/or lymphocytes, arranged around its nucleus within phagocytic vacuoles. Surrounding cells include lymphocytes, myeloid precursors and a mitotic figure. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context (HLH-2004 criteria), this supports hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei, and the engulfed cells remain viable, rather than within a histiocyte with a single round nucleus.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes show emperipolesis of lymphocytes and are S100 positive, usually in lymph nodes rather than marrow.
Truly engulfed cells lie within vacuoles enclosed by macrophage cytoplasm, not superimposed on top of it.

2782.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色下，一個界線清楚的圓形淋巴結節呈細胞膜棕色陽性（推測為 B 細胞標記如 CD20），周圍骨髓只有零星陽性細胞，顯示這是骨髓內以 B 細胞為主的淋巴濾泡。
features: Single well-circumscribed round lymphoid nodule with dense membranous brown staining
Positive cells concentrated within the nodule; scattered positive cells in the surrounding interstitium
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow largely negative
Nodule is intertrabecular rather than paratrabecular
Low magnification limits cytologic assessment
2782.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled; pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) at low power shows a single well-circumscribed, intertrabecular lymphoid nodule with dense membranous staining of its cells. Only scattered positive cells are present in the surrounding hematopoietic marrow. The circumscribed, non-paratrabecular B-cell nodule corresponds to the germinal center seen on H&E. Findings are consistent with a reactive B-cell follicle in the marrow; BCL2 and CD10 staining would help exclude follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma aggregates are typically paratrabecular and show BCL2 co-expression in CD10-positive follicle center cells.
Marginal zone lymphoma often shows multiple aggregates with intrasinusoidal spread and light chain restriction in plasmacytic cells.
CLL nodules are CD5- and CD23-positive small B cells with proliferation centers, not a germinal center with mantle.

2526.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中央有一顆核大、染色質細緻、胞質藍而無顆粒的原始細胞（blast），周圍為染色質粗顆粒、胞質深藍的紅血球前驅細胞及含顆粒的骨髓球，提示原始細胞增加的 MDS。
features: Central blast with large round nucleus, fine chromatin and a thin rim of agranular blue cytoplasm
Early erythroid precursors with coarsely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Myelocytes with oval nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Orthochromatic normoblasts with dense pyknotic nuclei
No Auer rods or obvious megaloblastoid change identifiable in this field
2526.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a blast with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, surrounded by basophilic erythroid precursors, myelocytes and orthochromatic normoblasts. No Auer rods are identified. Definite dysplastic features are not conspicuous in this single field, and the blast percentage cannot be derived from it. In the context of cytopenias and a 500-cell differential showing 5-19% blasts, findings would be consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Proerythroblasts have deeper blue cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing and coarser chromatin, unlike the paler agranular cytoplasm and fine chromatin of a myeloblast.
Promyelocytes are larger with abundant azurophilic granules and a paranuclear hof, whereas blasts are agranular or have only a few granules.
Normal marrow contains fewer than 5% blasts, so an increase must be established by a formal differential count rather than a single field.

2462.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個大型巨核細胞，細胞核分裂成多個彼此分離、圓形的小核（像散開的珠子，separated nuclear lobes），而不是正常相連的分葉核，這是發育不良巨核細胞的表現。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant pale granular cytoplasm
Multiple (about 8) widely separated, round to oval nuclear lobes without connecting chromatin bridges
Nuclear lobes of relatively uniform size with moderately condensed chromatin
Background of small lymphoid cells, erythroid precursors and platelet clumps
Thick smear areas with blood/plasma background
2462.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm containing multiple round, widely separated nuclear lobes rather than a single contiguous lobulated nucleus. The surrounding cells include small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors with scattered platelets. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a recognized dysplastic form. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia; if seen in >=10% of megakaryocytes, this supports a myelodysplastic or MDS/MPN process, after exclusion of reactive causes.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with lobes connected by chromatin rather than completely separated nuclei.
Osteoclasts contain many separate, uniform round nuclei with single nucleoli and lack platelet-forming granular cytoplasm, and occur near bone spicules.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes after chemotherapy or in HIV/B12 deficiency
ddx.vs: Reactive or megaloblastic changes can mimic separated lobes, so clinical history, cytogenetics and multilineage findings are needed.
Micromegakaryocytes are small with one or two nuclei, unlike this large multinucleated form.

2398.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆淋巴芽細胞：體積小到中等（約為紅血球的 1.5–2 倍），細胞質極少、無顆粒，核圓、染色質均勻細緻但偏濃，下方那顆可見小核仁，這種高核質比、無顆粒的芽細胞是 ALL 的典型形態。
features: Two small to medium blasts, about 1.5–2 times the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely stippled, homogeneous but moderately condensed chromatin
Small, inconspicuous nucleolus in the lower cell
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells normochromic; occasional platelets
2398.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratios, scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei with finely stippled homogeneous chromatin, and a small inconspicuous nucleolus in the lower cell. No Auer rods or granules are seen. The background red cells are normochromic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts; flow cytometric immunophenotyping (TdT, CD34, CD19/CD10 or cytoplasmic CD3) is required to confirm B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, more open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and may show granules or Auer rods, with MPO positivity.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, block-like clumped chromatin without nucleoli and are TdT/CD34 negative.
Hematogones are rarely seen in blood, have very homogeneous smooth chromatin and show a normal maturation pattern of CD10/CD20/CD34 on flow.

2142.recognize_zh: 薄層抹片中有數個核圓、染色質細緻、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞，旁邊有胞質粗顆粒的前驅細胞與一個胞質豐富淡染、核偏位的單核球樣細胞；單一視野只能看出芽細胞與顆粒球系異常，多系發育不良無法充分評估。
features: Blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Granulated precursor with coarse azurophilic granules (promyelocyte-like)
Monocytoid cell with eccentric folded nucleus and abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm (left)
Hypogranular cell with coarse chromatin (upper left) and a small lymphocyte (upper right)
Monolayer red cells with mild anisocytosis; no platelets conspicuous
2142.describe_en: Thin smear area shows several blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, together with a coarsely granulated promyelocyte-like cell, a monocytoid cell with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm, and a small lymphocyte. The red cells are in a monolayer with mild anisocytosis. Definite multilineage dysplasia is not demonstrable in this limited field. Findings support an acute myeloid leukemia; the subclassification as AML with multilineage dysplasia requires evaluation of dysplasia across the whole aspirate.

ddx.vs: AMML requires ≥20% monocytic cells in addition to myeloblasts, confirmed by NSE staining, rather than a single monocytoid cell.
Lacks ≥50% dysplasia in two lineages and MDS-related cytogenetics.
APL shows a predominant population of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rods rather than isolated granulated cells.

1950.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內一個模糊的結節狀小淋巴球聚集，中央有淡粉紅色玻璃樣物質與小血管（類似退化、萎縮的濾泡），周圍副皮質區則是含淡染細胞與梭形血管的多形性浸潤，右上可見纖維帶，屬 AITL 中退化濾泡的型態。
features: Vaguely nodular aggregate of small dark lymphocytes with a central pale eosinophilic hyalinized area containing small vessels (regressed follicle-like structure)
Surrounding polymorphous infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes, some with pale/clear cytoplasm
Numerous elongated vessels with plump endothelial cells in the interfollicular areas
Scattered histiocytes and plasma cells in the background
Fibrous band/vessel wall at the upper right
1950.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a vaguely nodular aggregate of small lymphocytes surrounding a central eosinophilic hyalinized area with small vessels, resembling a regressed follicle. The surrounding tissue contains a polymorphous infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes, some with pale cytoplasm, admixed with histiocytes and plasma cells and numerous vessels with plump endothelium. A fibrous band is present at the upper right. In the context of effaced nodal architecture, findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma with regressed (burnt-out) follicles, which should be confirmed with TFH markers (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS), CD21 for expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and T-cell clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Castleman disease has regressed follicles with concentric mantle zones and radially penetrating vessels but lacks atypical clear T cells and PD-1/CXCL13-positive expanded TFH populations.
Reactive hyperplasia preserves architecture with open sinuses and lacks clonal TFH-phenotype T cells and expanded perivascular CD21-positive meshworks.
PTCL-NOS lacks the TFH immunophenotype and the characteristic arborizing HEV and FDC meshwork proliferation.

1886.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下單一淋巴樣細胞的表面伸出大量細長、彎曲的細胞質突起（cytoplasmic projections），細胞核呈不規則凹陷形，符合毛狀細胞的超微結構外觀。
features: Transmission electron micrograph of a single mononuclear cell
Numerous long, slender, branching surface cytoplasmic projections
Irregular, indented nucleus with peripheral heterochromatin and a nucleolus
Moderate cytoplasm with scattered mitochondria; no specific granules
Detached villous processes in the surrounding field
1886.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph shows a mononuclear cell with an irregular, indented nucleus containing peripheral heterochromatin and a small nucleolus. The cytoplasm is moderate with scattered mitochondria, and the cell surface bears numerous long, slender, interdigitating cytoplasmic projections. The right portion of the image is blank (slide mount). Findings are consistent with a hairy cell, supporting hairy cell leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short, polar villi concentrated at one or two poles, whereas hairy cells have long circumferential projections; SMZL is CD103/annexin A1 negative.
Monocytes have ruffled membranes and lysosomal granules with a folded nucleus, and are CD14/CD68 positive and lack B-cell markers.
HCL-v cells also have projections but show a prominent central nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

1758.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面大體標本上散布多個大小不一、邊界清楚的灰白色結節（部分融合成簇），分布於紅褐色脾實質中，符合何杰金氏淋巴瘤侵犯脾臟的結節狀病灶。
features: Cut surface of a spleen with dark red-brown, homogeneous red pulp parenchyma
Multiple discrete, well-circumscribed gray-white nodules of variable size, from pinpoint to about 1 cm
Some nodules coalesce into small clusters, most prominent toward the subcapsular region
Many tiny pale foci diffusely scattered, possibly representing prominent white pulp or small deposits
No gross necrosis or hemorrhagic infarct evident
1758.describe_en: Gross photograph of a sectioned spleen shows multiple discrete, well-circumscribed gray-white nodules of variable size, some coalescent, scattered within dark red parenchyma, with numerous smaller pale foci. No infarcts or necrosis are grossly evident. The gross pattern is not specific and requires histologic confirmation. Findings are consistent with nodular splenic involvement by Hodgkin lymphoma, as seen in staging splenectomy specimens.

ddx.dx: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma (e.g., follicular or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Low-grade lymphomas usually cause uniform miliary enlargement of white pulp, while DLBCL forms larger solitary masses; separation requires histology and immunophenotyping.
Granulomas form small uniform miliary nodules and show epithelioid granulomas with or without caseation on histology rather than Reed-Sternberg cells.
Splenic metastases are uncommon, often larger and necrotic or pigmented, and are identified histologically by keratin or melanocytic markers.

1630.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見一群較大的細胞，核呈摺疊、凹陷、有核溝（grooved）或分葉，染色質淡、偶見小核仁，細胞質豐富淡粉紅且邊界不清，淋巴球很少；右側為纖維性間質。這些是組織球/樹突狀細胞樣細胞，需 IHC 分辨。
features: Aggregate of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Irregular nuclei that are folded, indented, grooved or lobulated
Vesicular chromatin with small nucleoli in some nuclei
Few admixed small lymphocytes
Fibrous stroma with spindle cells along the right edge
1630.describe_en: Section at high power shows an aggregate of large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, indistinct cell borders and irregular, folded to grooved or lobulated nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli. Small lymphocytes are sparse, and fibrous stroma is present at the right edge. Significant mitotic activity or marked pleomorphism is not seen. The cells have a histiocytic/dendritic cell appearance, as seen with sinus histiocytes, interdigitating dendritic cells or Langerhans cells in lymphoid tissue; precise identification requires immunohistochemistry (CD68/CD163, S100, CD1a, langerin).

ddx.vs: LCH cells have similar grooved nuclei but form sheets with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin-positive with BRAF V600E in many cases.
IDCs are S100-positive but CD1a-negative and sit in an expanded paracortex with melanin-laden macrophages.
ALCL cells are more pleomorphic with horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei, mitoses and strong CD30 positivity.
Tumor cells form cohesive nests with more atypical nuclei and are keratin- or SOX10/melan-A-positive.

1438.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中紅系前驅細胞明顯增生，箭頭指出的大型前驅細胞具圓形開放染色質與單一明顯核仁（類巨母紅血球樣 megaloblastoid erythroid precursors），並可見有絲分裂；H&E 無法顯示環狀鐵粒母細胞，因此只能支持紅系異常增生，需以鐵染色確認 RARS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with many erythroid precursors showing round, dark, condensed nuclei
Arrowed large precursors with round nuclei, open chromatin and single prominent central nucleoli, consistent with early/megaloblastoid erythroid cells
Occasional mitotic figures
Admixed granulocytic precursors and interstitial hemorrhage/proteinaceous material
No Prussian blue stain; ring sideroblasts not assessable
1438.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with prominent erythroid precursors, including arrowed large early erythroid cells with round nuclei, open chromatin and single prominent nucleoli, suggestive of megaloblastoid maturation. Occasional mitoses and admixed granulocytic precursors are present. Ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on H&E; a Prussian blue stain on the aspirate is needed to document the ring sideroblasts required for MDS with ring sideroblasts, and exclusion of an acute erythroid leukemia requires quantitative assessment.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (at least 30%) with erythroid cells over 80% of the marrow, rather than scattered early precursors.
Megaloblastic anemia shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with low B12/folate and responds to replacement.
Parvovirus produces giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and a paucity of maturing erythroid cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters with different immunophenotype, whereas these cells blend into an erythroid maturation sequence.

94.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被一片片小型、圓核、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質少的「類淋巴球樣」細胞取代，像淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤；但細胞核染色 cyclin D1 陽性、輕鏈原位雜交呈一側優勢，才認出是帶 t(11;14) 的漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to intermediate cells effacing the marrow space between trabeculae
Round, often eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli (lymphocyte-like/lymphoplasmacytoid cytology)
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; clear-cut clock-face plasma cells with a perinuclear hof are not prominent
Strong, uniform membranous staining of essentially all neoplastic cells on the membranous IHC panels
Nuclear cyclin D1 staining of variable intensity in most tumor cells
Light-chain ISH: diffuse cytoplasmic signal on one stain versus much sparser signal on the other, indicating light-chain restriction
94.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows near-total replacement of the intertrabecular space by diffuse sheets of monotonous small to intermediate-sized cells. At high power the cells have round, frequently eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and scant to moderate cytoplasm, imparting a lymphocyte-like rather than classic plasmacytic appearance; no follicular or paratrabecular nodular architecture is seen. Immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous staining of the infiltrate and diffuse nuclear cyclin D1 positivity, and kappa/lambda in situ hybridization shows marked predominance of one light chain (lambda, per the case data). The membranous marker identities are not labeled in the images. In conjunction with cytogenetic t(11;14)(IGH::CCND1), findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with t(11;14) showing lymphoplasmacytoid cytology.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a CD20+ B-cell component separate from a CD138+ plasma cell component, is cyclin D1 negative, and usually carries MYD88 L265P rather than t(11;14).

MCL is also cyclin D1+ with t(11;14), but the cells are CD5+ SOX11+ B cells lacking CD138 and cytoplasmic light-chain ISH signal, whereas myeloma cells are CD138+ with strong cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL has a dominant CD20+ monocytoid/centrocyte-like B-cell population with only a minor plasma cell component and is cyclin D1 negative.
CLL/SLL shows CD5+ CD23+ LEF1+ small B cells with proliferation centers and lacks CD138 and cytoplasmic light-chain positivity.

94.stain: H&E; IHC (membranous markers, cyclin D1); ISH: kappa/lambda
captions: H&E, medium power: marrow replaced by sheets of monotonous small round cells between trabeculae
H&E, high power: lymphocyte-like plasma cells with round eccentric nuclei and clumped chromatin
Membranous IHC (marker not labeled; e.g. CD138 or CD20): strong uniform staining of tumor cells
Membranous IHC (marker not labeled), second field: diffuse strong membrane staining
Cyclin D1 IHC: nuclear positivity of variable intensity in most tumor cells
Light-chain ISH: diffuse cytoplasmic signal, consistent with the restricted (lambda) light chain
Light-chain ISH, other light chain: sparser signal, supporting light-chain restriction

4062.recognize_zh: 真皮內圍繞汗腺與小血管有密集、單一型態的小至中型淋巴樣細胞浸潤，核深染、輪廓略不規則，浸潤細胞延伸入附屬器周圍；配合臨床已知 T-PLL，符合皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）。
features: Dense, fairly monotonous infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells in the dermis
Hyperchromatic round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant cytoplasm
Periadnexal distribution around eccrine coils and small vessels, with cells infiltrating between glandular structures
Surrounding dermal collagen largely spared; few interspersed other inflammatory cells
4062.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a dense periadnexal and perivascular dermal infiltrate composed of fairly monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, round to slightly irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm. The infiltrate surrounds and permeates eccrine glandular structures, while the adjacent reticular dermal collagen is relatively spared. Nucleoli are not well seen at this magnification and eosinophils or plasma cells are not prominent. In a patient with known T-prolymphocytic leukemia, findings are consistent with leukemia cutis; immunophenotyping (CD3, CD4/CD8, TCL1) is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL infiltrates are CD20+, CD5+, CD23+ B cells, whereas T-PLL is CD3+, TCL1+ and usually CD4+.
Mycosis fungoides shows epidermotropic atypical cerebriform lymphocytes with Pautrier microabscesses rather than a dermal periadnexal infiltrate from a leukemic process.
ATLL has flower-shaped nuclei, is CD25+ and HTLV-1 associated, and lacks TCL1 overexpression.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous, often with interface change and mucin, and lack clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement.
